bdZAOqTSho.method: The authors define preemptive unlearning, verify that retrospective methods give insufficient pre-release protection, and propose a gradient-sealing principle that pushes relevant pre-activations into the negative region where ReLU-family activations have zero or near-zero derivatives.
bdZAOqTSho.key_idea: Seal gradient pathways by driving relevant pre-activations to the negative region where ReLU-family derivatives vanish, so forbidden-domain data produces no useful gradient during fine-tuning.
bdZAOqTSho.evidence: Experiments across multiple LLM families comparing resistance to downstream acquisition against retrospective unlearning baselines.
bdZAOqTSho.claimed_gains: Stronger resistance to downstream acquisition than retrospective baselines across multiple LLM families; no numbers stated.

DGpl6hu4Qk.one_liner: Training-free sparsity for diffusion language models: reuse a compact historical KV subset and propagate only likely-updated queries through deep layers.
DGpl6hu4Qk.problem: Diffusion language model inference is costly from repeated attention over a growing historical prefix and from processing the entire current generation block at every denoising step even though few positions are resolved per step.
DGpl6hu4Qk.method: Duet builds a compact historical KV subset from the concentration and cross-step stability of attention within each generation block and reuses it across denoising steps. It predicts update positions from shallow representations and propagates only those queries through the suffix Transformer layers.
DGpl6hu4Qk.key_idea: Select a reusable prefix KV subset from stable historical attention, and use shallow-layer predictions of which positions will update to run only those queries through later layers.
DGpl6hu4Qk.evidence: Experiments on LLaDA2.1-mini and SDAR-8B-Chat-b32 at 32K context length measuring accuracy and speedup.
DGpl6hu4Qk.claimed_gains: 1.34x end-to-end and 2.83x per-step speedups on LLaDA2.1-mini and 2.41x and 4.72x on SDAR-8B-Chat-b32 at 32K context, with competitive accuracy.

RBQODZoVlZ.one_liner: Post-hoc correction of frozen forecasters that selects covariance resolution, ridge strength, and fitting source by cross-fitted validation.
RBQODZoVlZ.problem: Residual errors of frozen forecasting models mix persistent compensable patterns with stochastic training-run variation, and finite calibration data supports only some relationships between them.
RBQODZoVlZ.method: The authors formulate covariance-resolution selection, ranging from coordinate-wise scaling to channel, phase, and neighboring-mode interactions, fit closed-form candidates, and select resolution, ridge multiplier, and fitting source by cross-fitted validation. Theory characterizes linearly recoverable error and bounds corrective-gain estimation error.
RBQODZoVlZ.key_idea: Pick the covariance resolution of a closed-form spectral correction (coordinate-wise to cross-channel, phase, and neighbor-mode) by cross-fitted validation on how much structure the calibration data supports.
RBQODZoVlZ.evidence: A 320-case evaluation matrix, including outputs already enhanced by post-hoc adapters or training losses, with multi-seed spectral diagnostics and theoretical bounds.
RBQODZoVlZ.claimed_gains: Improves 279 of 320 settings with an average relative MSE reduction of 6.34%, versus 3.72% for the best fixed resolution.

xUxa60BiCG.one_liner: Learns a continuous self-adjoint Sturm-Liouville operator whose low-order eigenspace gives task-adapted global coordinates for sequence mixing.
xUxa60BiCG.problem: Spectral sequence methods use predefined coordinate systems such as Fourier or polynomial bases, so the retained global subspace stays largely fixed.
xUxa60BiCG.method: SLiK learns a continuous self-adjoint Sturm-Liouville operator end-to-end; eigenvalue-conditioned spectral responses transform sequence information in its low-order eigenspace, while a parallel multi-scale convolutional path keeps local and high-frequency structure.
xUxa60BiCG.key_idea: Learn the coordinate-defining Sturm-Liouville operator from the task so its low-order eigenspace gives adaptive global coordinates, with the continuous operator re-discretized across sequence lengths.
xUxa60BiCG.evidence: Four long-term forecasting benchmarks against Transformer, Mamba, and MLP baselines; matched 180M-parameter, 100B-token language-model pretraining; needle-in-a-haystack; long-read RNA sequence modeling (per TLDR).
xUxa60BiCG.claimed_gains: Competitive with strong Transformer, Mamba, and MLP baselines on forecasting, and 80.6% average needle-in-a-haystack at matched 180M parameters and 100B tokens (abstract truncated).

Z3M8L4BifD.one_liner: Evicts KV-cache entries in hybrid linear-attention models by aggregating multiple salient attention responses plus linear-layer token signals.
Z3M8L4BifD.problem: Existing KV-cache eviction targets attention-only architectures and ignores the distinct pathways of hybrid models, whose few remaining full-attention layers still have caches that grow linearly with context length.
Z3M8L4BifD.method: HybriKV aggregates evidence from multiple salient responses in the full-attention layers rather than relying mainly on the strongest one, and reserves a small portion of the cache budget for positions highlighted by linear-layer signals.
Z3M8L4BifD.key_idea: Score tokens by aggregating several salient attention responses, and reserve a slice of the cache budget for positions flagged by linear-layer signals.
Z3M8L4BifD.evidence: Evaluated on RULER, LongBench, and SCBench across hybrid LLMs from 7B to 48B (per TLDR; abstract truncated).
Z3M8L4BifD.claimed_gains: Near-lossless 2-3x KV-cache compression across hybrid LLMs from 7B to 48B (TLDR).

IhXXms16ty.one_liner: Formulates continuous-time RL over controlled CTMCs and derives PPO and GRPO variants to fine-tune score-based discrete diffusion models.
IhXXms16ty.problem: Existing GRPO-based fine-tuning of discrete diffusion models uses only terminal rewards and cannot use intermediate reward or advantage signals along the denoising trajectory.
IhXXms16ty.method: State dynamics are modeled as a controlled continuous-time Markov chain via stochastic control, giving policy gradients and continuous-time PPO and GRPO; for masked diffusion LLMs, trajectory subsampling estimates the otherwise prohibitive trajectory likelihoods.
IhXXms16ty.key_idea: Treat denoising as a controlled CTMC and derive continuous-time policy gradients, so rewards need not be differentiable and intermediate advantages can enter the trajectory.
IhXXms16ty.evidence: The visible abstract describes the theory and framework for score-based discrete diffusion and masked diffusion LLMs; experimental details are not shown (truncated).

jUBEgPiFQF.one_liner: Jointly optimizing action policy, forward/inverse dynamics, and future spatial state prediction trains a VLM for vision-and-language navigation.
jUBEgPiFQF.problem: Recent VLM navigation models treat continuous vision-and-language navigation primarily as direct action generation without explicitly modeling world states or their future evolution.
jUBEgPiFQF.method: FutureNav jointly encodes text, egocentric visual, and spatial features into an LLM and optimizes four objectives: navigation action prediction, forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and future spatial state generation. Explicit world modeling shapes the shared representation without slowing inference.
jUBEgPiFQF.key_idea: Co-train a multimodal LLM on navigation action prediction alongside forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and future spatial state generation objectives.
jUBEgPiFQF.evidence: Evaluated with a 4B-scale backbone on continuous vision-and-language navigation benchmarks R2R-CE and RxR-CE.

hZ6pYxr69u.one_liner: Decouples programmatic object-state world logic from an autoregressive box-conditioned video renderer for rule-controllable interactive worlds.
hZ6pYxr69u.problem: End-to-end video world models entangle interaction dynamics with pixel synthesis, preventing explicit specification and tracking of user-defined object rules.
hZ6pYxr69u.method: BoxWorld uses a coding agent to compile user-defined rules into a Box World Engine that tracks layout boxes, persistent object attributes, and dynamic status variables. A Box-State Generative Renderer—trained via open-domain grounding, gameplay transition learning, and self-rollout distillation—autoregressively renders this state stream into interactive video.
hZ6pYxr69u.key_idea: Separate symbolic interaction logic in an agent-synthesized box-state engine from visual synthesis in a rollout-distilled autoregressive video renderer.
hZ6pYxr69u.evidence: Trained on automatically annotated open-domain and gameplay videos with self-generated rollout distillation; downstream evaluation details are truncated in the abstract.

SLX4vJZTON.one_liner: Coordinates multi-agent generative view synthesis and graph-structured cross-checking to assemble spatial reasoning evidence from limited views.
SLX4vJZTON.problem: Single or limited input views omit occluded spatial cues, and uncoordinated viewpoint generation fails to integrate complementary premises or verify uncertain propositions.
SLX4vJZTON.method: ScoutCrew uses a Coordinator to organize subtasks in an Investigator Relation Graph with Complement and CrossCheck links, guiding Investigator agents that invoke generative view synthesis and exchange findings along the graph. An Analyst agent then synthesizes the revised investigator reports into a structured chain of evidence for the final answer.
SLX4vJZTON.key_idea: Plan generative viewpoint exploration over a complement-and-crosscheck relation graph before compiling revised multi-agent observations into a chain of evidence.
SLX4vJZTON.evidence: Evaluated across multiple VLM backbones on SAT-Real and multi-image MMSI-Bench against direct inference.
SLX4vJZTON.claimed_gains: Improves accuracy over direct inference across all evaluated backbones by up to 14.0 percentage points on SAT-Real and up to 9.5 percentage points on multi-image MMSI-Bench.

UKkwWcghJj.one_liner: Distills reasoning from visual-thought-conditioned teacher contexts into a shared-weight text-only student via on-policy token-level JSD.
UKkwWcghJj.problem: Generating interleaved visual thoughts in unified multimodal models requires expensive multi-step diffusion at inference while rendered images themselves contribute little direct accuracy gain.
UKkwWcghJj.method: Visual-OPSD pairs a teacher conditioned on privileged visual-thought traces with a shared-weight student conditioned only on the input question. Applying token-level Jensen-Shannon divergence distillation along on-policy student text rollouts transfers visual-pathway reasoning into fast text-only inference.
UKkwWcghJj.key_idea: Minimize token-level JSD on on-policy text rollouts between a shared-weight model conditioned on privileged visual thoughts and the same model conditioned only on the prompt.
UKkwWcghJj.evidence: Evaluated on ThinkMorph across nine spatial and multimodal benchmarks including VSP, with KL-gap diagnostics and Gaussian-noise visual-thought controls.
UKkwWcghJj.claimed_gains: Improves accuracy over its generative teacher by +3.40 percentage points across nine benchmarks at a 14.3× speedup (10.0s vs. 142.8s per sample), beats same-scale VLMs by +63.83 percentage points on VSP, and closes 58.4% of the teacher-student KL gap.

8C5YIHa9oQ.one_liner: Audits bug-localization file recall via controlled file-path perturbations, function-level selection checks, and downstream patch-repair cohorts.
8C5YIHa9oQ.problem: Standard file-level bug localization metrics mask reliance on surface file-path cues and fail to measure whether models identify the target function needed for program repair.
8C5YIHa9oQ.method: The study applies controlled path interventions—replacing original paths with opaque or unrelated readable names while holding issue reports and code fixed—across code rerankers and tool-using localizers. It further evaluates function-level selection accuracy following file hits and compares executed patch outcomes when repair agents receive whole files versus specified functions.
8C5YIHa9oQ.key_idea: Decompose file-level bug localization using controlled path-renaming interventions, post-hit function-selection audits, and whole-file versus function-specified repair evaluations.
8C5YIHa9oQ.evidence: Evaluates code rerankers trained with and without code previews, a tool-using source-reading localizer, function scorers, and program-repair cohorts under controlled path perturbations.
8C5YIHa9oQ.claimed_gains: Tested function scorers select an actually changed function on only 45.0% of file-hit records despite eligible targets usually appearing among candidates.

FrxiIrkLSN.one_liner: Probes and steers a linear activation direction governing multi-turn LLM answer capitulation under user pushback.
FrxiIrkLSN.problem: Language models abandon correct answers under multi-turn user challenge, while self-judged flip labels and linear-probe readability mislead behavioral measurement and causal intervention placement.
FrxiIrkLSN.method: The authors replace biased self-judgment with gold-free answer extraction to label genuine multi-turn capitulation, train question-held-out linear probes on hidden activations, and perform dose-dependent activation addition and subtraction across layers. They evaluate causal steering against prompt defenses and random-direction controls on both unwarranted flips and evidence-warranted corrections.
FrxiIrkLSN.key_idea: Extract a linear activation direction from validated capitulation labels and steer intermediate layers chosen by causal effect rather than probe readability.
FrxiIrkLSN.evidence: Behavioral labeling audits, question-held-out linear probing across multiple LLMs, and controlled causal steering experiments on two models comparing against prompt defenses and equal-norm random vectors.
FrxiIrkLSN.claimed_gains: Self-judging reports answer changes in up to 98% of conversations, whereas validated labels yield question-held-out linear probe AUROC of 0.96–0.99 across studied models.

H0aXBKpjLc.one_liner: Unifies metric-depth and multi-view generation with RL-gated adaptive geometric evidence synthesis for spatial reasoning.
H0aXBKpjLc.problem: Always generating visual or geometric intermediates is computationally wasteful, and it remains unclear when geometric generation actually improves spatial understanding.
H0aXBKpjLc.method: GeoUG pairs a multi-scale metric-depth codec on a pretrained visual autoencoder with joint understanding-and-generation training, evaluated alongside a 2D-cue-balanced benchmark (3DCueBench). At inference, an RL-trained policy drafts an initial answer and selectively invokes geometric evidence generation to verify or revise the draft when accuracy gains outweigh generation cost.
H0aXBKpjLc.key_idea: Train a unified depth-and-view generator with reinforcement learning to selectively synthesize geometric evidence only when revising an initial spatial-reasoning draft is worthwhile.
H0aXBKpjLc.evidence: Evaluated on CV-Bench-3D, the newly constructed 3DCueBench, and DA-2K comparing joint training and adaptive interleaved generation against always-generating baselines.
H0aXBKpjLc.claimed_gains: GeoUG reaches circular accuracies of 97.9% on CV-Bench-3D, 90.8% on 3DCueBench, and 94.2% on DA-2K while using fewer generation calls than always generating.

Q1JvJKZyrX.one_liner: DepthVLM attaches a lightweight depth head to a language backbone and jointly supervises dense geometry and language outputs.
Q1JvJKZyrX.problem: Text-only VLM supervision under-constrains dense geometry, while prior depth methods introduce distillation errors or inefficient and coarse predictions.
Q1JvJKZyrX.method: DepthVLM adds a lightweight depth head to the LLM backbone and trains with unified vision-text supervision in two stages. A single forward pass produces full-resolution metric depth maps alongside language outputs.
Q1JvJKZyrX.key_idea: Train an attached depth head and language backbone under shared vision-text supervision to produce dense geometry and text together.
Q1JvJKZyrX.evidence: A unified indoor-outdoor metric-depth benchmark supports comparisons with VLMs and pure-vision models, alongside complex three-dimensional spatial-reasoning evaluation.

640PrvnrT6.one_liner: FL4N learns temporal residuals over a pretrained static latent prior for feed-forward dynamic-scene novel view synthesis.
640PrvnrT6.problem: Explicit four-dimensional Gaussian representations in monocular feed-forward synthesis can produce temporal inconsistency and rendering artifacts.
640PrvnrT6.method: FL4N represents scenes in a unified space-time latent representation and learns temporal dynamics as residuals over a pretrained static prior. A lightweight dynamic encoder uses static features to distinguish object motion from camera parallax, training solely through image synthesis.
640PrvnrT6.key_idea: Encode dynamic scene changes as residuals on a static latent prior while separating object motion from camera-induced parallax.
640PrvnrT6.evidence: The abstract reports real-time novel-view rendering and generalization to real-world videos, without naming evaluation datasets or baselines.

BJKJsbKw8d.one_liner: ObjDream separates object identity and state, routes attention by identity, and trains action-conditioned predictions of future object states.
BJKJsbKw8d.problem: Image-level representations in vision-language-action models lack object detail needed for manipulation under shifted layouts, clutter, and backgrounds.
BJKJsbKw8d.method: A spatiotemporal object encoder forms temporal slots with separate identity and state channels, which enter the VLM token sequence through identity-guided attention routing. An action-conditioned dynamics module supervises future object-state evolution during training without requiring future prediction at inference.
BJKJsbKw8d.key_idea: Separate persistent identity from changing object state, route attention to object tokens, and supervise their action-conditioned future evolution.
BJKJsbKw8d.evidence: The supplied abstract names LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 experiments but truncates their results.

v0qYt9gvh9.one_liner: LoGo gives every token local attention and learns which tokens receive full-context attention under a controlled global budget.
v0qYt9gvh9.problem: Uniform or statically assigned attention spans waste computation on tokens that do not require long-range context.
v0qYt9gvh9.method: Coupled local and global branches give all tokens a restricted context window while a learned gate selects tokens for full-context access. A threshold controller maintains the global ratio, progressive masking stabilizes training, and query-sparse Triton kernels implement sparse global computation.
v0qYt9gvh9.key_idea: Gate full-context attention per token while maintaining universal local attention and a threshold-controlled global-attention ratio.
v0qYt9gvh9.evidence: Experiments across model sizes examine preservation of full-attention scaling behavior, but the supplied abstract truncates the controlled-comparison results.

dAvnnDpemh.one_liner: GeoTrans transports diffusion world-model states through geometric correspondences with online gains calibrated from completed anchor transitions.
dAvnnDpemh.problem: Repeated denoising is expensive, and temporal caching alone misses coherent state changes among geometrically corresponding tokens.
dAvnnDpemh.method: GeoTrans refreshes anchors using temporal drift and a horizon limit, then decomposes proposed state displacements into geometry-shared and residual components. Closed-form gain estimates from completed anchor transitions determine accepted updates without extra transformer evaluations or gradients.
dAvnnDpemh.key_idea: Decompose skipped-denoising state updates by geometric correspondence and calibrate component gains from observed anchor transitions.
dAvnnDpemh.evidence: Voyager and Aether experiments compare speed and fidelity against WorldCache, with controlled ablations isolating geometric state transport.
dAvnnDpemh.claimed_gains: GeoTrans achieves 4.25× and 1.96× acceleration on Voyager and Aether, respectively, with improved generation fidelity over WorldCache.

oIbBg1Szyv.one_liner: Lightning OPD 2.0 subtracts cross-fitted recurring style disagreement before constructing token-level cross-teacher distillation updates.
oIbBg1Szyv.problem: A strong distillation teacher may provide little improvement when its style differs from the teacher behind the supervised reference.
oIbBg1Szyv.method: Rollout-level cross-fitting estimates recurring teacher-reference disagreement as a proxy for style-token bias. Lightning OPD 2.0 subtracts this component before forming token-level on-policy distillation updates, retaining context-specific teacher evidence.
oIbBg1Szyv.key_idea: Estimate recurring teacher-reference disagreement across rollouts and residualize it out of token-level distillation supervision.
oIbBg1Szyv.evidence: Mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks compare against Lightning OPD using three SFT references across Qwen and Olmo families.
oIbBg1Szyv.claimed_gains: Starting from Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, Lightning OPD 2.0 reaches 82.4% on AIME 2024 and 63.0% on LiveCodeBench v5.

2LN3rZeePs.one_liner: A learned bridge converts large-model prefill states into attention keys and values for small-model decoding.
2LN3rZeePs.problem: Text-based model collaboration incurs large-model decoding costs before smaller models can use its guidance.
2LN3rZeePs.method: POND uses a frozen sender only for prefill and maps its hidden states to additional receiver attention keys and values. Optional review passes process partial receiver outputs to refresh guidance while preserving the receiver's existing KV cache.
2LN3rZeePs.key_idea: Map frozen sender prefill representations into extra attention keys and values consumed throughout the small receiver's autoregressive generation.
2LN3rZeePs.evidence: Reasoning and coding evaluations pair Qwen receivers with GLM-5.3 and Qwen3.8-Max senders and test transfer from math-and-code training to general knowledge.

bQRrUu8i0q.one_liner: Spectral responses generalize rooted graph invariants into structural encodings with stronger graph-distinguishing power.
bQRrUu8i0q.problem: Existing spectral-invariant constructions do not exploit the broader range of rooted graph invariants used in graph learning.
bQRrUu8i0q.method: Spectralization interprets existing spectral invariants as spectral responses to the identity signal and extends that construction to arbitrary rooted graph invariants. It spectralizes WL atomic types and derives structural encodings.
bQRrUu8i0q.key_idea: Apply the spectral-response construction previously used for the identity signal to arbitrary rooted graph invariants.
bQRrUu8i0q.evidence: Theoretical results place Spectralized k-FWL within a hierarchy of classical and spectral WL variants and show expressiveness gains from spectralizing rooted graph invariants.
bQRrUu8i0q.claimed_gains: Spectralized k-FWL is strictly more expressive than k-FWL for every k ≥ 2.

wgxqE0mSam.one_liner: A common deployment-feedback interface standardizes performative prediction and supports trust-region surrogate learning.
wgxqE0mSam.problem: Performative-prediction implementations entangle algorithms with response models and feedback assumptions, hindering reuse and comparison.
wgxqE0mSam.method: PP-Gym separates environments, observations, learners, and evaluation through a shared deployment-feedback interface. TR-CLS models deployment-dependent loss and selects decisions using individual records or aggregate feedback.
wgxqE0mSam.key_idea: Separate deployment feedback from learner implementations and fit a trust-region cross-loss surrogate to guide new deployment decisions.
wgxqE0mSam.evidence: The shared protocol evaluates 26 methods and variants across 13 tasks with immediate or gradual responses and individual-record or aggregate feedback.
wgxqE0mSam.claimed_gains: TR-CLS lowers average learning loss on nine tasks, including a 14.3% revenue increase in simulated ten-product pricing.

KPAR0dhwok.one_liner: Patch self-similarity, weighted second-moment pooling, and cross-image matching enable training-free visual place retrieval.
KPAR0dhwok.problem: Training-based place recognition requires expensive labels and struggles with domain changes, while training-free features can lack discriminative power.
KPAR0dhwok.method: UniPS extracts patch features from a frozen backbone and estimates patch importance through self-similarity. Weighted second-moment pooling provides coarse rankings, followed by cross-image patch-similarity reranking.
KPAR0dhwok.key_idea: Weight frozen patch features by self-similarity, pool their second moments for coarse retrieval, then rerank through cross-image patch matching.
KPAR0dhwok.evidence: The supplied abstract reports evaluation on 17 visual place recognition benchmarks.

FRgF9IcoQy.one_liner: Element-wise temporal differences and reduced nuisance variation recover useful evidence for AI-generated video detection.
FRgF9IcoQy.problem: Temporal detectors conflate generation evidence with preprocessing and motion variation, weakening detection.
FRgF9IcoQy.method: The study replaces scalar temporal summaries with element-wise differences and progressively reduces major non-generative variation. It evaluates the resulting temporal evidence and its fusion with spatial evidence.
FRgF9IcoQy.key_idea: Preserve element-wise inter-frame differences while reducing preprocessing and motion-related variation, then combine debiased temporal evidence with spatial evidence.
FRgF9IcoQy.evidence: Controlled representation analyses and progressive nuisance-reduction experiments use GenVideo and cross-benchmark evaluation on unseen GenVidBench.
FRgF9IcoQy.claimed_gains: On shortcut-controlled GenVideo, a spatial-only detector reaches about 0.95 AUC versus around 0.80 for existing temporal detectors.

7xkhSLzAmn.one_liner: Eliminating conductances from a shared energy couples adaptive graph dynamics with Gibbs-induced edge uncertainty.
7xkhSLzAmn.problem: Continuous graph models often fix noisy observed geometry without jointly adapting it and quantifying uncertainty.
7xkhSLzAmn.method: Stochastic Graph Flows eliminate positive edge conductances from an entropy-regularized energy to obtain the state-dependent Laplacian driving representation dynamics. At positive temperature, a Gibbs law over representation states induces mean geometry and edge uncertainty through the conductance map.
7xkhSLzAmn.key_idea: Eliminate conductances from a joint energy, evolve representations with its induced Laplacian, and push the Gibbs law through the conductance map.
7xkhSLzAmn.evidence: Theory establishes free-energy dissipation, Gibbs invariance, and conditional operator and spectral-subspace stability, with synthetic and real-graph experiments.

rT6sTWto1q.one_liner: Joint label-and-evidence reinforcement learning targets verifiable reasoning for AI-generated video detection.
rT6sTWto1q.problem: Label-only supervision and reference-model-generated rationales can limit detector generalization and introduce unreliable evidence.
rT6sTWto1q.method: VidForensics-M1 proposes meta-detection that jointly supervises label correctness and evidence correctness during reinforcement learning. The supplied abstract motivates verifiable evidence targets but does not specify their representation.
rT6sTWto1q.key_idea: Supervise both detection labels and their supporting evidence during reinforcement learning using verifiable evidence targets.

9oY3grog4V.one_liner: Reliability-scored frames and tool evidence guide confidence-aware video reasoning and reinforcement learning.
9oY3grog4V.problem: Video reasoning models treat degraded frames as reliable evidence, causing accuracy losses under blur, glare, or occlusion.
9oY3grog4V.method: Robust-TO selects frames using reliability and relevance, then collects temporally grounded predictions and calibrated reliability scores from perception tools. These scores guide three-tier evidence synthesis and a confidence-cost GRPO reward.
9oY3grog4V.key_idea: Select frames by reliability and relevance, weight tool evidence by calibrated confidence, and train with a reward combining correctness, reliability, and cost.
9oY3grog4V.evidence: Evaluation covers two video reasoning benchmarks spanning eight tasks, including clean inputs.
9oY3grog4V.claimed_gains: Robust-TO achieves 56.4% average accuracy on clean inputs.

0hKKRMK7JU.one_liner: Tokenized panel geometry and geometry-conditioned flow prediction separate garment shape generation from stitching.
0hKKRMK7JU.problem: Sewable garment design requires expertise, while predefined panel-edge and stitching representations constrain generation.
0hKKRMK7JU.method: SartorAI represents panels as closed 2D curves with stitching connections between boundary points. An RQ-VAE tokenizes panel geometry for VLM generation, and a flow model predicts stitching from the generated geometry.
0hKKRMK7JU.key_idea: Generate discrete panel-geometry tokens with a VLM, then predict boundary-point stitching connections using a geometry-conditioned flow model.

TMMYQQHXCq.one_liner: Shared ranked outputs compare static retrievers and search agents on visually rich documents with compositional evidence requirements.
TMMYQQHXCq.problem: One-shot query-page matching and downstream answer scoring leave iterative document ranking underexplored.
TMMYQQHXCq.method: VisDocAgentBench constructs direct, one-bridge, and two-bridge queries over a closed document corpus under a shared ranking protocol. Relation-preserving query construction includes full-document review and hard-negative validation.
TMMYQQHXCq.key_idea: Vary the number of evidence bridges required to identify a target document while holding the ranked-output evaluation contract fixed.
TMMYQQHXCq.evidence: The benchmark contains 2,375 pages from 100 documents and 120 queries, with planner comparisons and iterative-search and page-inspection ablations.
TMMYQQHXCq.claimed_gains: A visual retriever achieves 97.50% Recall@1 on direct items and 2.50% on two-bridge items, while agents' best visual-retrieval R@1 reaches 67.50% versus 37.50% for OCR-text.

n60W8VR7Nx.one_liner: Branching video trajectories evaluate how streaming generators respond to interventions while preserving interaction history.
n60W8VR7Nx.problem: Endpoint-quality evaluations miss responsiveness and history preservation during multi-round streaming video interaction.
n60W8VR7Nx.method: WorldLineBench constructs branching worldlines from interventions at designated points in 45-second videos. It evaluates the interaction process using four metrics across two capability dimensions.
n60W8VR7Nx.key_idea: Branch an unfolding video at intervention points and assess response, fulfillment, and preservation across multiple history-dependent rounds.
n60W8VR7Nx.evidence: Evaluation covers seven models from three paradigms using 1,000 synthetic and 1,000 real videos across five content contexts and seven interaction types.

1ihfTCOu91.one_liner: Hadamard-transformed, compressed representations select token-level attention candidates before gathering original key-value states.
1ihfTCOu91.problem: Long-context attention is costly, while coarse sparse selection can discard useful tokens or retain redundant ones.
1ihfTCOu91.method: Adamas applies Hadamard transforms, bucketization, and 2-bit compression to create compact representations. Lightweight distance estimates select top-k positions whose original KV states supply sparse attention.
1ihfTCOu91.key_idea: Estimate top-k attention candidates from Hadamard-transformed, bucketized, 2-bit representations and gather their original KV states.
1ihfTCOu91.evidence: Evaluations report near-lossless performance within Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct's effective context length and measure efficiency at a 32K context length.
1ihfTCOu91.claimed_gains: Adamas achieves up to 6.5× self-attention speedup and 1.7× end-to-end decoding speedup at a 32K context length.

uFpDYS4TH3.one_liner: Semantic queries and multiscale spatial features decode category-specific maps directly from fMRI responses.
uFpDYS4TH3.problem: Image reconstructions from fMRI can obscure whether semantic content comes from measured brain responses or generative priors.
uFpDYS4TH3.method: BrainSeg maps fMRI responses into semantic queries and multiscale spatial features that jointly predict dense maps over 133 categories. A frozen MaskFormer supplies offline training targets, while inference uses fMRI alone.
uFpDYS4TH3.key_idea: Couple fMRI-derived semantic queries with multiscale spatial features to predict category locations directly under frozen segmentation-teacher supervision.
uFpDYS4TH3.evidence: Natural Scenes Dataset tests assess category presence, localization, and segmentation, with shuffled fMRI-stimulus pairings, category-conditioned layout controls, and a reconstruction-model comparison.

5Apsk8BaFs.one_liner: Learned decision-dependent distribution maps support stochastic bilevel optimization of nonconvex performative risk.
5Apsk8BaFs.problem: Standard stochastic bilevel methods assume fixed data distributions even when deployed decisions change both optimization levels' distributions.
5Apsk8BaFs.method: AdaBiO iteratively estimates unknown upper- and lower-level distribution maps from explored samples while performing stochastic bilevel optimization. It targets stationary points of performative risk.
5Apsk8BaFs.key_idea: Jointly estimate both decision-dependent distribution maps and update the bilevel optimizer toward a stationary point of performative risk.
5Apsk8BaFs.evidence: The paper proves convergence and tests strategic credit classification against stocBiO, a performatively stable-point baseline, and AdaBiO with known distribution maps.
5Apsk8BaFs.claimed_gains: AdaBiO reaches an ε-stationary point with O(ε^-2) computational complexity and O(ε^-1) additional sample complexity for estimating distribution maps.

T2LjlcdfvD.one_liner: Item Response Theory directs task selection and repository-scale vulnerability-task synthesis for adaptive coding-agent evaluation.
T2LjlcdfvD.problem: Static security benchmarks have fixed coverage and difficulty, while vulnerable repositories and expert-written replacement tasks are scarce.
T2LjlcdfvD.method: SecProbe estimates agent ability from observed performance using Item Response Theory. It selects existing tasks or synthesizes repository-scale vulnerability-repair tasks where additional evidence would be most informative.
T2LjlcdfvD.key_idea: Use estimated agent ability to choose informative vulnerability-repair tasks and synthesize missing evaluation cases on demand.
T2LjlcdfvD.evidence: Evaluation uses 353 tasks across five programming languages and 149 CWE types, nine models, two agent harnesses, and random and one-shot baselines.
T2LjlcdfvD.claimed_gains: Success rates peak at 28.33%, and SecProbe obtains comparable ability estimates while requiring agents to solve up to 29.5% fewer tasks.

NSYfro1Rkn.one_liner: Semantic-consensus partitions discover multimodal intents, then reliability-guided predictions transfer those categories to unseen samples.
NSYfro1Rkn.problem: Direct MLLM categorization can collapse categories and fragment intent structure, hindering generalization to unseen interactions.
NSYfro1Rkn.method: IntentForge uses sample-level MLLM descriptions to organize a consensus-based semantic view and discover fixed training partitions. IntentBridge transfers the resulting categories to unseen samples through reliability-guided pointwise prediction.
NSYfro1Rkn.key_idea: Discover intent partitions from training-wide semantic consensus, then assign unseen samples through reliability-guided pointwise prediction.
NSYfro1Rkn.evidence: Experiments evaluate intent-discovery accuracy on MIntRec, MELD-DA, and IEMOCAP-DA.
NSYfro1Rkn.claimed_gains: The framework achieves 62.95%, 47.70%, and 39.49% accuracy on MIntRec, MELD-DA, and IEMOCAP-DA, respectively.

paT4NcZxBy.one_liner: Trajectory-level safety diagnosis identifies unsafe behavior, localizes its first occurrence, and characterizes the associated capability failure.
paT4NcZxBy.problem: Final-behavior safety benchmarks miss when and why tool-using agents become unsafe during multi-turn interactions.
paT4NcZxBy.method: The benchmark generates multi-turn attack cases through dynamic agent interaction and human annotation. A progressive evaluation pipeline judges safety, localizes the first risky step, and diagnoses failures across four safety capability dimensions.
paT4NcZxBy.key_idea: Trace each unsafe rollout to its first risky step and use that step's context to diagnose the failed safety capability.
paT4NcZxBy.evidence: The benchmark contains 1,100 cases, including 525 English and 575 Chinese cases, across 125 scenarios, six attack strategies, and five tool categories.

6FEw1esZ1j.one_liner: Kuramoto synchronization couples diffusion dynamics to preserve spatiotemporal structure in decision trajectories.
6FEw1esZ1j.problem: Stochastic noising erases robotic trajectories' spatiotemporal dependencies, weakening action fluidity and long-horizon planning.
6FEw1esZ1j.method: KDDM combines Langevin and Kuramoto dynamics to encode synchronization within forward and reverse diffusion. It also supports ODE-accelerated and guided sampling.
6FEw1esZ1j.key_idea: Couple Langevin diffusion with Kuramoto synchronization to encode spatiotemporal dependencies throughout noising and denoising.
6FEw1esZ1j.evidence: The paper provides convergence and comparative theoretical results and evaluates trajectory augmentation, long-horizon planning, and real-world robotic control against diffusion-based methods.

GCPTdL1JNC.one_liner: Household videos spanning normal, emerging-risk, and realized-anomaly situations test perception, reasoning, intervention timing, and mitigation planning.
GCPTdL1JNC.problem: General video benchmarks do not systematically assess the capabilities needed to anticipate and address household hazards.
GCPTdL1JNC.method: HomeACE combines real and generated household videos across normal, risk-only, and abnormal situations. Its evaluation protocol assesses Perception, Cognition, Temporal, and Planning capabilities.
GCPTdL1JNC.key_idea: Evaluate household hazard understanding across risk stages using separate perception, causal reasoning, timing, and mitigation-planning dimensions.
GCPTdL1JNC.evidence: Experiments assess current MLLMs on more than 14K household videos, including nearly 3K real recordings and over 11K generated videos.

bIYLgqUnkT.one_liner: Instance-grounded character handles bind player actions and NPC rules to flexible roles in shared-view game simulation.
bIYLgqUnkT.problem: Fixed player and NPC assignments limit multi-character game models, especially when visually similar characters share a viewpoint.
bIYLgqUnkT.method: ReactiveGWM grounds learned character handles in initial-frame instance masks through Spatial Role Binding. Unified Agency Conditioning binds character-specific token groups containing player actions or conditional NPC rules to those handles.
bIYLgqUnkT.key_idea: Bind control-token groups to instance-grounded character handles so one model simulates externally controlled players and reactive NPCs.

E5Axj84LvZ.one_liner: Closed-form regression coefficients compress token sequences through a regression problem learned end-to-end.
E5Axj84LvZ.problem: Pooling and learned projections form an underperforming information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models.
E5Axj84LvZ.method: TTR-Compressor turns input tokens into a regression problem whose fitted coefficients become the compressed representation. Backpropagation learns the regression problem, while the forward pass computes its coefficients in closed form.
E5Axj84LvZ.key_idea: Represent a sequence by closed-form fitted coefficients of an input-dependent regression problem learned through backpropagation.
E5Axj84LvZ.evidence: Experiments evaluate block-wise sparse attention on RULER and visual-token merging in multimodal LLMs against attention-based compressors and an MLP merger.
E5Axj84LvZ.claimed_gains: TTR-Compressor matches the standard MLP merger's performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens.

t4mxrDk437.one_liner: Target-aligned latent perturbations and altered token-attention structure protect portraits against unauthorized diffusion-transformer personalization.
t4mxrDk437.problem: Existing unlearnable-example objectives largely target U-Net models and leave diffusion-transformer structures insufficiently addressed.
t4mxrDk437.method: DiTCloak aligns VAE encoding and diffusion prediction toward a shared target pattern while anchoring token relations and reorienting multi-head attention. It optimizes image perturbations by alternating surrogate adaptation with projected gradient descent.
t4mxrDk437.key_idea: Optimize portrait perturbations jointly against latent target alignment, token relations, and multi-head attention within diffusion transformers.
t4mxrDk437.evidence: The supplied abstract reports experiments on CelebA-HQ and VGGFace2.

OSovQwLAFt.one_liner: Cross-appearance teacher-student alignment trains world action models to preserve action representations under irrelevant visual perturbations.
OSovQwLAFt.problem: Video prediction preserves appearance information without requiring action representations to ignore task-irrelevant visual changes.
OSovQwLAFt.method: PICA-WAM feeds nominal observations to an EMA teacher and perturbed observations to the online world action model. A projection head aligns the online model's shallower action representation with the teacher's deeper-layer target.
OSovQwLAFt.key_idea: Align shallow action features from perturbed observations with deeper features from an EMA teacher processing nominal observations.
OSovQwLAFt.evidence: Experiments evaluate three world action models on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO-Plus, and a real robot under visual perturbations.
OSovQwLAFt.claimed_gains: PICA-WAM raises real-robot success from 33.1% to 67.5%.

slH0HSbKjn.one_liner: Split textual and visual editing intent tests whether image-editing safeguards detect harmful transformations across modalities.
slH0HSbKjn.problem: Image-editing models can reconstruct unsafe intent distributed across inputs while safeguards fail to assess the combined transformation.
slH0HSbKjn.method: SIJA distributes editing intent between textual references and auxiliary visual cues, while SI2ESBench evaluates this vulnerability. The paper proposes jointly reconstructing editing intent as a defense principle.
slH0HSbKjn.key_idea: Distribute editing intent across text and visual cues so evaluating either modality alone misses the complete requested transformation.
slH0HSbKjn.evidence: SI2ESBench experiments test representative commercial and open-source image-editing models, including GPT Image 2 and Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro.
slH0HSbKjn.claimed_gains: SIJA achieves attack success rates of 68.28% on GPT Image 2 and 91.38% on Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro.

ce0PwbWId1.one_liner: Joint latent-space denoising repeatedly separates an extracted 3D part from its remaining object.
ce0PwbWId1.problem: Post-generation segmentation fixes geometry too early, while additive part generation can create incompatible boundaries and materials.
ce0PwbWId1.method: SCULPT starts from a complete object in structured 3D latent space and repeatedly predicts an extracted part and the remainder together. Coupled denoising conditions on the image and current 3D state over the union of both outputs' sparse supports.
ce0PwbWId1.key_idea: Jointly denoise each extracted part and remaining object on overlapping sparse 3D supports, then repeat the split.

8aLXPIB9Ru.one_liner: History-graph reachability and Weisfeiler-Leman refinement flag temporal link queries lacking source-specific propagated evidence.
8aLXPIB9Ru.problem: Expressive-power guarantees do not reveal whether temporal link-prediction queries supply the connectivity needed for message passing.
8aLXPIB9Ru.method: The training-free audit flags targets outside the source's receptive field or indistinguishable from reachable negatives under Weisfeiler-Leman refinement. It diagnoses available propagated evidence without treating the flag as an accuracy ceiling.
8aLXPIB9Ru.key_idea: Flag queries whose targets are unreachable from the source or indistinguishable from reachable negatives under Weisfeiler-Leman refinement.
8aLXPIB9Ru.evidence: Proofs characterize missing source-specific signals and the absence of an accuracy bound, while experiments on two graphs test architectures, degree and depth controls, and feature ablations.

bLQ22POBgo.one_liner: Closed-form residual fitting repairs attacked-model representations while constraining output changes on utility activations.
bLQ22POBgo.problem: Harmful fine-tuning changes internal representations, so aligned and attacked models can reach the same module along different activation trajectories.
bLQ22POBgo.method: CCTR fits cross-trajectory output residuals on attacked-model representations while constraining drift on task-agnostic utility activations. Each target linear module yields a regularized least-squares problem solved without gradient optimization or downstream supervision.
bLQ22POBgo.key_idea: Fit aligned-reference output residuals on attacked-model activations through regularized least squares constrained by utility-activation preservation.
bLQ22POBgo.evidence: Experiments compare safety repair across harmful-data ratios and downstream tasks against the strongest reported safety-repair baseline.
bLQ22POBgo.claimed_gains: CCTR lowers average Harmful Score from 2.30% to 0.38% across harmful-data ratios and from 2.85% to 0.77% across downstream tasks.

XBWz0wdQR7.one_liner: Sensor-predicted Gaussian primitives define a continuous field proposal and condition a residual correction decoder.
XBWz0wdQR7.problem: Many sparse-sensor reconstructors use latent features that do not explicitly define a physical field over the target domain.
XBWz0wdQR7.method: FluidWeave predicts anisotropic Gaussian primitives from an unordered sensor set and aggregates them through a partition of unity into a normalized field proposal. A correction decoder conditions on the complete primitive state.
XBWz0wdQR7.key_idea: Use sensor-derived Gaussian primitives as shared spatial state for both a continuously queryable field proposal and its residual correction.
XBWz0wdQR7.evidence: Theory derives error and sensitivity results, and experiments cover Cylinder, AirfRANS, FlowBench LDC-3D, PhySense-Car, and PhySense-Sea.

oIwGs50Wjt.one_liner: Removing encoder residual connections and aggregating features across depths supports abstraction and detailed conditioning in diffusion transformers.
oIwGs50Wjt.problem: Encoder residual paths can limit progressive abstraction even though denoising still requires low-level details.
oIwGs50Wjt.method: DDT-RFE removes residual connections around encoder self-attention and MLP operations while retaining stable training. It fuses input patch embeddings with intermediate and final encoder features to condition the velocity decoder.
oIwGs50Wjt.key_idea: Force successive encoder transformations without residual bypasses, then recover multi-scale detail by aggregating features from multiple depths.
oIwGs50Wjt.evidence: Evaluation covers image classification, semantic segmentation, object discovery, semantic correspondence, and ImageNet generation FID against DDT.

Ta0GR70Yz4.one_liner: Grounded meme reconstruction followed by verifier-guided tree search expands harmful-semantic training coverage.
Ta0GR70Yz4.problem: Harmful-meme datasets have weak cross-modal grounding and limited coverage of alternative expressions of the same harmful meaning.
Ta0GR70Yz4.method: Reconstruct-then-Evolve first reconstructs source memes into semantically grounded examples. Verifier-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search then varies expression strategies, scenes, templates, and visual styles while preserving harmful semantics.
Ta0GR70Yz4.key_idea: Preserve each meme's harmful meaning during reconstruction, then search verified alternative realizations to expand the training distribution.
Ta0GR70Yz4.evidence: Evaluation covers four harmful-meme benchmarks and multiple detector backbones without changing detector architecture or inference.
Ta0GR70Yz4.claimed_gains: Synthesized data raise accuracy by 5.1-10.7 percentage points across four benchmarks and by 7.4-10.7 percentage points over fine-tuning on original data across detector backbones.

zdCDVB1RA8.one_liner: STAR calibrates identity-motion-sensitive timestep windows and backpropagates terminal identity rewards through sampled anchor steps.
zdCDVB1RA8.problem: Identity-preserving video post-training must improve facial identity without unnecessarily suppressing facial motion.
zdCDVB1RA8.method: Timestep perturbation probes jointly measure identity similarity and facial dynamics to calibrate an anchor window. STAR samples anchors from that window for single-leap backpropagation while an identity-forward connector scores the fully generated video, separating timestep coverage from gradient depth.
zdCDVB1RA8.key_idea: Identity-motion perturbation responses select an anchor window through which terminal-video identity rewards enter the denoising trajectory.
zdCDVB1RA8.evidence: The study builds HQ4000 with 4,000 annotated clips and evaluates HunyuanVideo-1.5 at 50 and 12 steps, Wan2.2 at 50 steps, and MiniMax-H3, with test500 identity and facial-dynamics assessment.
zdCDVB1RA8.claimed_gains: STAR improves test500 identity similarity by 9.8%–35.6% over base models while preserving facial dynamics.

ArbtExFqwo.one_liner: Alignment-loss outlier rejection filters atypical samples from REPA updates using adaptive cross-batch statistics.
ArbtExFqwo.problem: REPA weights every sample equally despite differences in alignment quality and alignment-gradient behavior.
ArbtExFqwo.method: Reject-REPA filters alignment-loss outliers with a sigma-based threshold grounded in the Vysochanskij-Petunin inequality, a combined Z-score and MAD detector, and cross-batch exponential moving averages.
ArbtExFqwo.key_idea: Reject samples with atypical alignment losses using Z-score and MAD detection with thresholds adapted through cross-batch exponential moving averages.
ArbtExFqwo.evidence: Variational and gradient analyses connect REPA to conditional mutual information, while empirical measurements associate rejected samples with weaker alignment and higher alignment-to-denoising gradient-norm ratios.

shh6iVylD6.one_liner: Cross-frame state tracking allocates query-dependent token budgets and routes context for compressed video temporal grounding.
shh6iVylD6.problem: Appearance-based token compression can erase state transitions and fragment entity trajectories needed to locate event boundaries.
shh6iVylD6.method: TIDE tracks token correspondences across frames to identify piecewise-stable states and assigns token budgets using query-conditioned transition signals. Soft state-compatible routing recovers peripheral context.
shh6iVylD6.key_idea: Track cross-frame token correspondences, allocate budgets using query-conditioned transitions, and route peripheral context through compatible states.
shh6iVylD6.evidence: Experiments use Qwen3-VL-8B on ActivityNet-Captions and compare temporal-grounding mIoU against a full-token baseline.
shh6iVylD6.claimed_gains: At 12.5% visual token retention on ActivityNet-Captions, TIDE outperforms the full-token baseline in mIoU with Qwen3-VL-8B.

x3dUiKEsSw.one_liner: Group-wise Fourier transforms and conjugate symmetry accelerate equivariant linear layers without retraining.
x3dUiKEsSw.problem: Dense implementations of equivariant layers lose computational savings from weight sharing, while prior Fourier approaches require architecture changes and incur memory overhead.
x3dUiKEsSw.method: Flash EQ-Linear combines the convolution theorem and conjugate symmetry for finite cyclic groups while preserving regular-representation interfaces. Dedicated CUDA kernels implement the resulting arithmetic for pretrained models.
x3dUiKEsSw.key_idea: Apply group-wise Fourier transforms and exploit conjugate symmetry to reduce multiplications while preserving equivariant layer interfaces.
x3dUiKEsSw.evidence: An arithmetic derivation for finite cyclic groups and operator-level comparisons against PyTorch F.linear on the p4 group support the method.
x3dUiKEsSw.claimed_gains: Flash EQ-Linear reduces multiplication cost to 2(T-1)/T^2 and achieves up to 2.1× forward speedup over PyTorch F.linear on the p4 group.

CiOJaUF1Ir.one_liner: Taxonomy-guided generated and recorded interactions test whether multimodal assistants detect demands and infer contextual user intent.
CiOJaUF1Ir.problem: Response-quality benchmarks underexamine whether assistants can infer underspecified demands and avoid false triggers in noisy multimodal conversations.
CiOJaUF1Ir.method: ODU-Bench combines taxonomy-guided agentic video generation with human-recorded interactions, media-grounded annotation, and human verification. It evaluates demand detection and intent inference across five dimensions in single-turn and multi-turn settings.
CiOJaUF1Ir.key_idea: Build taxonomy-guided multimodal interactions and verified annotations to test demand presence and contextual intent inference.
CiOJaUF1Ir.evidence: The benchmark evaluates 14 native audio and audio-visual multimodal large language models across single-turn and multi-turn interactions.

UAnhyxopqM.one_liner: Timeline-aligned frame embeddings combine semantic and temporal contrastive learning for audio-visual matching.
UAnhyxopqM.problem: Semantic embedding models discard temporal information, while synchronization models predict offsets without reusable semantic representations.
UAnhyxopqM.method: FATE retains frame-level audio and visual sequences, aligns them on the physical timeline, and computes similarity over strictly aligned frame pairs. Training combines cross-video semantic and within-video temporal contrastive objectives.
UAnhyxopqM.key_idea: Compare strictly time-aligned frame embeddings trained with cross-video semantic and within-video temporal contrastive objectives.
UAnhyxopqM.evidence: Evaluations cover temporal and semantic retrieval, zero-shot event localization against fully supervised methods, and correlation with human judgments for generation evaluation.

A7WmvSSrsf.one_liner: Completed scene occupancy guides object voxel refinement and frozen mesh generation from sparse RGB-D views.
A7WmvSSrsf.problem: Sparse observations leave incomplete object geometry and make coherent spatial arrangement difficult in compositional 3D scene generation.
A7WmvSSrsf.method: CoVoGen completes world-coordinate scene occupancy from posed RGB-D views and instance masks, then extracts object voxels with a learned membership classifier. Object refinement combines these voxels with neighboring occupancy and aligned observations before a frozen geometry generator produces meshes.
A7WmvSSrsf.key_idea: Extract object voxels from completed shared scene occupancy, refine them with neighboring geometry and observations, and decode meshes with a frozen generator.
A7WmvSSrsf.evidence: Comparisons use the same input views on four benchmarks containing 1,129 scenes and 6,880 target objects, measuring object and scene F@5 and Mean F.
A7WmvSSrsf.claimed_gains: CoVoGen improves scene F@5 by up to 4.57 percentage points over the best baseline.

LWytqLskTe.one_liner: Progressive executable-world tasks test whether coding agents translate visual understanding and high-level goals into functioning 3D systems.
LWytqLskTe.problem: Existing evaluations insufficiently measure the combination of world understanding and executable code-based world construction.
LWytqLskTe.method: ExeWorldBench evaluates mechanism realization from visual observations, composition of mechanisms with spatial and causal dependencies, and world synthesis from high-level goals and rules.
LWytqLskTe.key_idea: Test executable world construction through individual mechanisms, causally dependent multi-stage systems, and goal-directed synthesis.
LWytqLskTe.evidence: The benchmark defines three tasks with increasing complexity and autonomy, but the supplied abstract truncates its description of experiments.

q5NpkqNLNY.one_liner: Teacher-agreement credit assignment and auxiliary gradient projection coordinate conflicting supervision in multi-teacher on-policy distillation.
q5NpkqNLNY.problem: Domain-specific teacher routing still produces conflicting updates on shared student parameters and can degrade capabilities during joint optimization.
q5NpkqNLNY.method: ROAD MOPD uses non-routed teachers as auxiliary critics on student-generated trajectories to weight token corrections by teacher agreement. Adaptive gradient projection constrains conflicting updates while retaining target-domain learning signals.
q5NpkqNLNY.key_idea: Use cross-teacher agreement to weight token corrections and auxiliary teacher gradients to adaptively project conflicting student updates.
q5NpkqNLNY.evidence: The supplied abstract reports experiments mitigating degradation in a disadvantaged domain but does not identify datasets or models.

M3vheUan4w.one_liner: Action-dependent orthogonal rotations compose in execution order to encode motion relations between robot action tokens.
M3vheUan4w.problem: Position-based action-token encodings overlook the motion caused by actions and the order in which they execute.
M3vheUan4w.method: AT-RoPE maps each noisy action to an orthogonal operator and composes operators in execution order to define token encodings. A complementary pathway for rotary-attention backbones conditions query-key matching on the compared actions.
M3vheUan4w.key_idea: Compose action-dependent orthogonal operators in execution order so relative token encodings represent the intervening action sequence.
M3vheUan4w.evidence: Evaluations across four VLA and WAM backbones report improved success on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 and zero-shot robustness on LIBERO-Pro and LIBERO-Plus.

4PyZlo63QT.one_liner: Hierarchical tournament sampling embeds watermark bits with entropy-adjusted strength and confidence-weighted decoding.
4PyZlo63QT.problem: Static logit perturbations and hard-count decoding can degrade text quality and message recovery as multi-bit watermark payloads grow.
4PyZlo63QT.method: WorldCup embeds bits through hierarchical candidate-token competitions guided by complementary functions and modulates watermark strength using local entropy. Decoding aggregates evidence from agreement across tournament layers.
4PyZlo63QT.key_idea: Embed message bits through hierarchical token tournaments, adapt strength to local entropy, and decode by confidence-weighted agreement across tournament layers.
4PyZlo63QT.evidence: Experiments span multiple LLMs and downstream tasks, comparing message capacity, detectability, robustness, text quality, and decoding efficiency against prior baselines.

kxNzvXV8O1.one_liner: A likelihood-ratio transformation of a Dirichlet-process prior yields Bayesian risk posteriors under covariate shift.
kxNzvXV8O1.problem: Bayesian conformal risk control under exchangeability does not cover deployment shifts with estimated likelihood ratios.
kxNzvXV8O1.method: The method pushes a Dirichlet-process prior on the calibration distribution through a likelihood ratio to obtain a deployed-risk posterior conditional on the weight function. Finite-sample bounds account for weight-estimation error and conditional shift.
kxNzvXV8O1.key_idea: Transform a Dirichlet-process calibration prior through likelihood-ratio weights to construct a posterior over deployed risk for every threshold.
kxNzvXV8O1.evidence: The paper derives an exact posterior conditional on weights and finite-sample risk bounds, then evaluates synthetic and real covariate shifts in regression and classification.

RGowEtgmWn.one_liner: Cross-sample relation and threshold-exceedance matching improve synthetic data for ANN-to-SNN knowledge distillation.
RGowEtgmWn.problem: Batch-normalization means and variances alone do not determine spike threshold-crossing behavior when synthesizing data for ANN-to-SNN distillation.
RGowEtgmWn.method: STARS adds Relational Consistency Alignment to match teacher-student cross-sample relations and Tail-Aware Regularization to match soft exceedance probabilities at teacher-derived feature thresholds. Existing teacher priors remain active during synthesis.
RGowEtgmWn.key_idea: Match teacher-student cross-sample relations and soft feature-threshold exceedance probabilities alongside batch-normalization priors during surrogate-data synthesis.
RGowEtgmWn.evidence: Experiments cover CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet across multiple ANN-SNN pairs and three data-free distillation baselines, with paired multi-seed and resource measurements.
RGowEtgmWn.claimed_gains: STARS reaches absolute accuracy gains of 4.6% on CIFAR-10 and 6.7% on CIFAR-100.

nm7OkC1HB8.one_liner: Category prototype distillation and reliability-controlled visual residuals adapt frozen SAM3 to cross-domain few-shot segmentation.
nm7OkC1HB8.problem: Reference-target appearance differences destabilize visual matching, while category prototypes cannot represent all target appearances.
nm7OkC1HB8.method: D²-SAM3 distills ground-truth-box-prompted predictions into a category prototype and calibrates visual correspondence separately for each category to form residual predictions. Reliability-aware fusion weights these residuals using correspondence reliability and prototype uncertainty with SAM3 frozen.
nm7OkC1HB8.key_idea: Fuse a distilled category prototype with calibrated visual residuals weighted by correspondence reliability and prototype prediction uncertainty.

BD6Ba3FgW7.one_liner: Entropy-based routing selects between distilled fuzzy-rule predictions and a concept-augmented neural branch for medical image classification.
BD6Ba3FgW7.problem: Rule-based concept models often lose accuracy, while always using neural predictions makes symbolic explanations irrelevant to the final decision.
BD6Ba3FgW7.method: CLAIR-Med learns concepts from language-model vocabularies and vision-language pseudo-targets, then feeds them to predictive and fuzzy-rule branches. Class-level distillation trains the Deep Concept Reasoner, whose predictive entropy routes each input between branches.
BD6Ba3FgW7.key_idea: Distill predictive information into a fuzzy-rule concept reasoner and route inputs using the reasoner's output entropy.
BD6Ba3FgW7.evidence: Experiments on five medical image datasets and CUB report a narrower predictive-DCR utility gap without degrading predictive-branch accuracy and assess selective symbolic prediction.

bw7hexJ2fs.one_liner: Sequentially aligned functional operators merge transformers along partially merged execution paths before factorization into model parameters.
bw7hexJ2fs.problem: Independent layer merging ignores composed attention operators and activation changes caused by previously merged components.
bw7hexJ2fs.method: Sequential Local Operator Alignment estimates local component behavior with calibration data and merges operators under activations from the partially merged model. Factorizing these operators back into transformer parameters also permits rank expansion for multi-task capacity.
bw7hexJ2fs.key_idea: Align composed operators sequentially using partially merged activations, then factorize each merged operator into valid transformer parameters.
bw7hexJ2fs.evidence: Experiments examine error accumulation and generalization across modalities, scales, and task counts using CLIP, RoBERTa, and billion-parameter LLMs.

jC2JkM3EYS.one_liner: Declared research designs guide natural-language hypothesis selection through document measurements and effect estimates with uncertainty.
jC2JkM3EYS.problem: Hypothesis-discovery selection criteria can misalign with the population claims researchers intend to investigate.
jC2JkM3EYS.method: The framework converts natural-language predicates into document-level measurements and evaluates candidates using effect estimates and uncertainty under a declared research design. A peer-review testbed examines changing perceptions of research contributions.
jC2JkM3EYS.key_idea: Select natural-language hypotheses using testable document predicates and effect estimates aligned with a declared research design.
jC2JkM3EYS.evidence: Analyses use a decade of public submissions and peer reviews, including accepted and rejected papers, for temporal contribution trends and acceptance prediction beyond ratings and year.

xmEaMO4noX.one_liner: Corruption and reconstruction of human artifacts train an external skill library without updating language-model parameters.
xmEaMO4noX.problem: Specialized LLM skills otherwise require costly parameter adaptation, additional human annotation, or passive summarization of high-quality examples.
xmEaMO4noX.method: The approach iteratively reconstructs human artifacts through a diffusion-inspired forward-loss-backward loop that updates an agent's external skill library. It uses existing high-quality artifacts without additional annotations or external rewards.
xmEaMO4noX.key_idea: Corrupt and reconstruct human artifacts through an iterative forward-loss-backward process that updates external skills instead of model parameters.
xmEaMO4noX.evidence: Short-drama screenwriting experiments evaluate whether agents extract generalizable writing skills from human-authored scripts and improve domain-specific generation.

vI823T4gSD.one_liner: Graph metanetworks embed upstream parameterized computations to predict representation similarity and select layers for model reuse.
vI823T4gSD.problem: Direct representation comparisons require reference inputs and internal activations from each candidate model.
vI823T4gSD.method: The framework maps each internal site to a graph-metanetwork embedding of its upstream computations, accounting for hidden-coordinate permutations and attention-basis transformations. Learned similarity estimates guide layer retrieval and stitching candidate selection in unseen models.
vI823T4gSD.key_idea: Embed each internal site's upstream parameterized computation graph to predict representation relations while accounting for coordinate and attention-basis transformations.
vI823T4gSD.evidence: Structural analysis supplies conditional guarantees, and experiments report relation estimation, low-regret layer retrieval, and useful stitching connections without training on stitching outcomes.

lzZpEiW6aq.one_liner: Query-perturbation retention frequencies provide pairwise ranking supervision for black-box retrieval corruption attacks.
lzZpEiW6aq.problem: Treating top-k retrieval membership as binary supervision ignores hidden ordering information exposed by retrieval behavior.
lzZpEiW6aq.method: RV-KCA perturbs queries without changing semantics and estimates each document's stability from its top-k retention frequency. It selects pairs with clear stability differences to train a margin-aware surrogate retriever.
lzZpEiW6aq.key_idea: Infer document ordering from top-k retention frequencies under query perturbations and train a surrogate retriever on stability-separated document pairs.
lzZpEiW6aq.evidence: The analysis relates retention probability monotonically to retrieval score under a shared local noise model and characterizes sampling uncertainty in stability estimates.

4OInujSgtd.one_liner: Co-evolves an agent policy and its skill library by alternating Fork-GRPO skill invocation with counterfactual-utility skill editing.
4OInujSgtd.problem: Existing agentic skill-learning methods either train a policy against a static skill library or evolve skills under a frozen model rather than adapting both jointly in the deployment harness.
4OInujSgtd.method: Skill^2 alternates training two distinct roles around a shared skill library: an actor trained via Fork-GRPO, which forks a control branch at each skill decision to assign credit to invocation tokens, and an extractor trained via counterfactual-utility policy optimization, which rewards library edits by the actor's paired performance gain.
4OInujSgtd.key_idea: Alternate training an actor via control-branch-forked GRPO on skill invocation decisions and a skill extractor via counterfactual-utility policy optimization rewarded by paired actor gains.
4OInujSgtd.evidence: Evaluated on seven long-horizon terminal and web agentic benchmarks across Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B model scales.
4OInujSgtd.claimed_gains: Achieves relative gains of up to 46.7% on terminal tasks and 59.8% on web tasks over baselines, with average gains increasing from Qwen3.5-4B to Qwen3.5-9B.

qcXYhyyzVO.one_liner: Generates input-conditioned full-resolution spatial kernels via nonlinear pointwise projections before O(N log N) frequency-domain token mixing.
qcXYhyyzVO.problem: Self-attention incurs O(N^2) token-mixing cost while standard O(N log N) frequency-domain convolution uses static post-training filters or weak frequency-pointwise conditioning.
qcXYhyyzVO.method: Fluxer (instantiated as backbone Vision Fluxer, ViF) generates a full-resolution dynamic convolution kernel in the spatial domain via a nonlinear pointwise projection of the input feature map and applies it via frequency-domain filtering, inducing a bilinear interaction between two nonlinear views of the input.
qcXYhyyzVO.key_idea: Project input features nonlinearly in the spatial domain to form a dynamic global convolution kernel applied in frequency space, creating a bilinear view interaction.
qcXYhyyzVO.evidence: Three theoretical separations against static spectral filters, local convolution, and frequency-pointwise masks, paired with ImageNet-1K vision-backbone experiments.

gGR4HPBubR.one_liner: Parameterizes discrete-time survival models jointly over interval count K and temporal basis dimension M with held-out oracle selection.
gGR4HPBubR.problem: Discrete-time survival models exhibit strong empirical sensitivity to interval count K because existing families lock covariate-effect flexibility M to fixed paths such as M = 1 or M = K.
gGR4HPBubR.method: The paper introduces a unified temporal basis survival family parameterized jointly by temporal resolution K and covariate-effect basis dimension M, derives distinct oracle scales K* ~ n^(1/(2r+1)) and M* ~ (n/d)^(1/(2s+1)), and selects (K, M) via held-out joint validation without knowing smoothness parameters r and s.
gGR4HPBubR.key_idea: Decouple discrete-time interval resolution K from covariate-effect temporal basis dimension M and select (K, M) jointly via held-out validation to match distinct oracle error rates.
gGR4HPBubR.evidence: Minimax/oracle excess-risk proofs for held-out (K, M) selection, controlled simulation studies, and experiments across six real-world survival datasets and four deep-survival heads.

gGFagTzuHD.one_liner: Diagnoses and corrects probability-mass misallocation across expression levels in single-cell perturbation prediction models.
gGFagTzuHD.problem: Single-cell perturbation predictors systematically misallocate probability across cellular gene-expression levels even when mean expression is predicted accurately, distorting downstream biological conclusions.
gGFagTzuHD.method: The paper characterizes the structure and objective-level causes of expression-level probability misallocation across perturbation-modeling paradigms and introduces targeted corrections to realign predicted cellular expression distributions.
gGFagTzuHD.key_idea: Diagnose distributional probability misallocation across cellular expression levels that persists under mean-accurate predictors and apply targeted supervision and modeling corrections to realign predicted expression distributions.
gGFagTzuHD.evidence: Distributional error analysis, training-objective characterization, and empirical evaluations across single-cell perturbation modeling paradigms and datasets.

i12y1jaija.one_liner: NLI response graphs weighted by image-intervention sensitivity and cross-model semantic entropy rank black-box LMMs without labels.
i12y1jaija.problem: Unsupervised ranking of black-box large multimodal models without labeled target data is vulnerable to shared language priors that cause models to agree on incorrect answers.
i12y1jaija.method: MAVER builds an NLI-weighted semantic response graph from single responses per candidate model and measures cluster prevalence and connectivity. It perturbs the input image while holding the question fixed to weight answers by visual dependence and weights examples by cross-model semantic entropy.
i12y1jaija.key_idea: Combine NLI-based cross-model response agreement with counterfactual image-perturbation sensitivity and cross-model semantic entropy to rank black-box multimodal models without labels.
i12y1jaija.evidence: Evaluated across 32 large multimodal models and 15 datasets (comparison results truncated in the abstract).

IIM3lwufgg.one_liner: Counterfactual difference-in-differences activation analysis isolates sparse FFN neurons that causally steer affective empathic responses in LLMs.
IIM3lwufgg.problem: It is unclear whether recognizing user distress and generating supportive empathic responses in LLMs rely on shared representations or separable response-generation mechanisms.
IIM3lwufgg.method: A counterfactual difference-in-differences activation framework contrasts matched supportive and neutral responses across distress and non-distress contexts to control for input distress sensitivity and generic helpfulness. This isolates sparse post-gating FFN units—Supportive Empathic Response (SER) neurons—tested via direct activation suppression and steering.
IIM3lwufgg.key_idea: Contrast activations across matched supportive versus neutral responses and distress versus non-distress contexts using difference-in-differences to isolate response-specific empathy neurons.
IIM3lwufgg.evidence: Tested via activation tracking and direct causal interventions across four LLM families using EPITOME empathy metrics and ESConv support-strategy evaluations.
IIM3lwufgg.claimed_gains: Suppressing frozen SER neurons reduces EPITOME-based expressed empathy by 10.3%–31.9% relative to baseline across four model families and shifts ESConv responses toward instrumental support.

iczD09Gtn4.one_liner: Procedural instructions and visual cues are compiled into standalone skill images whose editable sources co-evolve with agent experience.
iczD09Gtn4.problem: Text-only or separately presented visual references leave multimodal agents struggling to integrate procedural instructions with visual state checks and keep both consistent during skill updates.
iczD09Gtn4.method: SkillCard compiles textual instructions and visual references into unified standalone skill images while retaining an editable structured source representation. During interaction and training, agent experience triggers source-level revisions that are recompiled into updated visual skill cards for reuse and policy co-evolution.
iczD09Gtn4.key_idea: Compile procedural text and visual state references into single composite skill images backed by editable source specifications updated from agent experience.
iczD09Gtn4.evidence: Evaluated on Visual ALFWorld and Visual WebShop (detailed metrics truncated in the abstract).

Tg5dgB11Wp.one_liner: Closed-loop vision-language-action policy iteratively refines editable segmentation contours via state-conditioned feature routing and entropic credit transport GRPO.
Tg5dgB11Wp.problem: Single-pass cascaded vision-language segmentation architectures use static feature interfaces that limit adaptive multi-referent perception and iterative boundary correction.
Tg5dgB11Wp.method: ContourVLA formulates generalized referring expression segmentation as a closed-loop visuomotor policy where editable contours act as explicit states updated by geometric action chunks. Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling adapts boundary sampling and multilevel feature routing to contour states, while Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) optimizes discrete grounding and continuous contour updates using soft instance correspondences.
Tg5dgB11Wp.key_idea: Represent segmentation masks as editable contour states updated in a closed loop via contour-conditioned feature routing and optimal-transport instance-credit GRPO.
Tg5dgB11Wp.evidence: Evaluated on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB splits against referring segmentation baselines (additional benchmarks truncated in the abstract).
Tg5dgB11Wp.claimed_gains: ContourVLA improves gIoU over the strongest evaluated baselines by 7.4, 2.8, and 2.7 points on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB, respectively.

PAzIljW7QJ.one_liner: Patch-embedding retrieval selects nonredundant candidate concepts from broad lists before MLLM refinement to characterize image dataset differences.
PAzIljW7QJ.problem: Relying on MLLMs to propose candidate concepts and global image embeddings to score them is costly and misses low-prevalence, multi-concept differences between image distributions.
PAzIljW7QJ.method: The workflow screens a broad candidate list using fine-grained patch-level embeddings with nonredundant selection criteria, then spends MLLM inference on optimizing the selected natural-language concepts to fit distribution differences. The authors also construct a multi-concept, low-prevalence dataset-diffing benchmark.
PAzIljW7QJ.key_idea: Select diverse candidate concepts from broad lists via patch-level embeddings, then refine those selected concepts with MLLM optimization.
PAzIljW7QJ.evidence: Systematically compared against MLLM-proposal and image-level embedding baselines on a proposed low-prevalence, multi-concept dataset-diffing benchmark and concept-correlation/bias detection tasks.

OKJbYF4UTg.one_liner: Frozen base-model token probabilities modulate dynamic fine-tuning loss weights to preserve viable alternative continuations under multi-sample decoding.
OKJbYF4UTg.problem: Dynamic Fine-Tuning sharpens demonstrated token probabilities at the expense of high-probability alternative reasoning continuations, degrading high-k pass rates in multi-sample decoding.
OKJbYF4UTg.method: Reference-Aware Dynamic Fine-Tuning (RA-DFT) queries the frozen base model's teacher-forced token probability as a local confidence signal within standard supervised fine-tuning. It attenuates DFT sharpening at low-reference-probability positions where alternative reasoning paths are plausible while retaining strong sharpening at high-reference-probability positions.
OKJbYF4UTg.key_idea: Scale token-level dynamic fine-tuning loss weights by the frozen base model's reference probability to reduce probability contraction at uncertain branching tokens.
OKJbYF4UTg.evidence: Evaluated across five language models and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks over a range of pass@k budgets against Dynamic Fine-Tuning and base models.

J6nLg2u3rl.one_liner: Benchmarks long-horizon agent planning under time-varying outcomes, disruptions, and persistent commitments from prior actions.
J6nLg2u3rl.problem: Static or isolated-disruption benchmarks do not capture continuously evolving environments and enduring commitments that constrain future agent decisions.
