J6nLg2u3rl.method: DynPlanBench combines Time-Indexed Dynamics, where states and outcomes depend on execution time, with Event-Driven Dynamics that introduce task-specific disruptions. Agents must plan temporally and replan around commitments created by earlier execution.
J6nLg2u3rl.key_idea: Jointly model execution-time-dependent world transitions and persistent action commitments so agents must replan within an evolving executable environment.
J6nLg2u3rl.evidence: The benchmark evaluates 20 frontier LLMs on 153 executable tasks spanning logistics, retail, and travel, with analyses of temporal inconsistency and commitment-related failures.
J6nLg2u3rl.claimed_gains: Even the best-performing model achieves only a 48.7% success rate.

b47jrUdTcU.one_liner: Combines recurrent-state and attention signals with age-aware blocking to compress hybrid-model KV caches.
b47jrUdTcU.problem: Transformer-only eviction ignores recurrent-state dynamics and globally prunes contiguous context needed by hybrid language models.
b47jrUdTcU.method: StacKV retains low-magnitude recurrent-update tokens alongside high-attention tokens, addressing what to keep. Age-aware non-uniform spatial blocking determines where to retain entries and limits compounding local-context loss during rolling eviction.
b47jrUdTcU.key_idea: Fuse recurrent-update magnitude with attention retention scores and organize eviction into age-dependent non-uniform spatial blocks.
b47jrUdTcU.evidence: Training-free compression experiments span five tasks and compare against existing KV-cache baselines on hybrid language models.
b47jrUdTcU.claimed_gains: StacKV maintains over 95% of full-cache performance on average for each model at a 25% retention budget.

l5ad06xjLE.one_liner: Jointly learns length-compressed embeddings, flow matching, and token decoding for efficient continuous language diffusion.
l5ad06xjLE.problem: Two-stage latent compression fixes embeddings before diffusion training, making them difficult to model and reliably decode into tokens.
l5ad06xjLE.method: JPEG-DLM jointly trains a compressor, flow-matching model, and decoding module using joint-embedding prediction. Co-adaptation produces structured compressed embeddings intended for both diffusion modeling and reliable token reconstruction.
l5ad06xjLE.key_idea: Optimize compressed latent embeddings jointly with the flow-matching generator and token decoder rather than freezing a separately learned representation space.
l5ad06xjLE.evidence: LM1B and OWT experiments compare throughput and generative perplexity against recent diffusion and flow models at multiple latent-compression settings.
l5ad06xjLE.claimed_gains: At compression rate 0.5 on OWT, JPEG-DLM reaches Gen-PPL 34.52 and approximately 2.3× ELF’s throughput.

e4BdeJw74a.one_liner: Uses monocular depth to gate spectral wave propagation of RGB evidence for structure-preserving image dehazing.
e4BdeJw74a.problem: Directly fusing uncertain hazy-image depth with RGB can entangle geometric boundary errors with the appearance being reconstructed.
e4BdeJw74a.method: GeoHaze drives a projected damped-wave spectral operator with spatially gated depth responses while RGB remains the appearance carrier. RGB-depth wavelet statistics predict wave speed and damping, a residual gate controls feedback, and a frequency-decoupled decoder restores layout and detail.
e4BdeJw74a.key_idea: Condition nonlocal RGB evidence propagation on uncertain geometry through depth-gated wave speed, damping, and residual response control rather than direct feature fusion.
e4BdeJw74a.evidence: Experiments cover 11 natural and remote-sensing dehazing benchmarks with controlled wave variants and depth analyses.

LAt8avZY0Y.one_liner: Discovers symmetry-compatible governing equations by searching differential invariants derived from infinitesimal symmetry generators.
LAt8avZY0Y.problem: Direct PDE discovery must select relevant terms from a vast search space while respecting physical symmetries.
LAt8avZY0Y.method: The pipeline computes differential invariants for a symmetry group’s infinitesimal generators and uses them as candidate equation terms. DI-SINDy instantiates this lossless local coordinate reduction within sparse equation discovery.
LAt8avZY0Y.key_idea: Replace generic candidate terms with differential invariants of the symmetry group, reducing the equation search while preserving symmetry exactly.
LAt8avZY0Y.evidence: Across a series of PDEs, DI-SINDy is compared with other symmetry-informed discovery methods, with additional tests of dataset noise, symmetry noise, and unknown-symmetry high-dimensional systems.

7D9rAZImR8.one_liner: Benchmarks neural graph-edit-distance models on direct cross-dataset transfer and multi-collection training.
7D9rAZImR8.problem: Neural GED methods are usually evaluated within one graph collection, leaving transfer of exact-GED supervision across collections unclear.
7D9rAZImR8.method: The benchmark unifies exact graph pairs, node alignments, and representative learning-based GED methods under a cross-collection evaluation. It compares direct transfer, exposure to multiple source collections, and adaptation with limited target supervision.
7D9rAZImR8.key_idea: Evaluate GED models on unseen graph collections and measure how multi-source training changes transfer and subsequent target adaptation.
7D9rAZImR8.evidence: The open benchmark contains 5,523 graphs and 1,903,452 exact graph pairs from 11 collections and evaluates 20 learning-based methods against four approximations.
7D9rAZImR8.claimed_gains: Eighteen methods beat the best-of-four approximation on source collections, but none retains that advantage under direct cross-collection transfer.

JthkLGR9bk.one_liner: Benchmarks goal-directed quantitative strategy generation and refinement from natural-language investment objectives and backtest feedback.
JthkLGR9bk.problem: LLMs’ ability to find quantitative strategies satisfying specified investor goals under limited backtesting remains insufficiently evaluated.
JthkLGR9bk.method: AlphaGoal provides validated atomic strategies and programmatically verified reachable goals for strategy generation and parameter optimization. AlphaLoop serves as a reference agent that uses factor information and backtesting feedback to construct and refine strategies.
JthkLGR9bk.key_idea: Evaluate strategy search against empirically reachable natural-language investment goals under a unified historical backtest and limited evaluation budget.
JthkLGR9bk.evidence: The benchmark includes 175 atomic strategies and 2,221 tasks grounded in up to 11.5 years of daily data across 5,941 stocks, with six LLMs evaluated.

u8WCasb06w.one_liner: Targets under-covered hidden-state regions with safety-preference augmentation and coverage-scaled direct preference optimization.
u8WCasb06w.problem: Safety-aligned LLMs often fail on out-of-distribution harmful inputs associated with weak representation-space coverage of safety training data.
u8WCasb06w.method: CovDPO computes a Hidden-State Coverage Score for local safety-preference coverage. The score guides preference-data generation toward under-covered failure regions and scales DPO losses according to coverage.
u8WCasb06w.key_idea: Use hidden-state neighborhood coverage both to select safety-preference augmentation targets and to weight preference-optimization updates.
u8WCasb06w.evidence: Experiments span four OOD harmful benchmarks, three jailbreak attacks, and Llama-3-8B and Qwen3-8B model families, including over-refusal evaluation.
u8WCasb06w.claimed_gains: CovDPO reduces average attack success from 15.90% to 2.41% on Llama-3-8B and from 11.21% to 4.60% on Qwen3-8B.

EAPLudodCg.one_liner: Equalizes delivered expert energy within a shared spectral frame when merging reinforcement-learning-verified-reward experts.
EAPLudodCg.problem: RLVR task vectors have low-precision sparsity and heterogeneous update energy that undermine sparsification heuristics and supply-determined spectral merging.
EAPLudodCg.method: DESA reallocates expert-level delivered energy while preserving a shared spectral frame. Controlled budget equalization and retention floors prevent sensitive experts from receiving insufficient allocation.
EAPLudodCg.key_idea: Explicitly allocate each expert’s delivered spectral energy with equalized budgets and retention floors instead of letting update energy determine recovery.
EAPLudodCg.evidence: Training-free merging experiments cover both language and vision-language RLVR expert pools and compare average accuracy and recovery against strong baselines.

QLMHtA7hoi.one_liner: Adapts mid-to-late MLLM attention layers using video-level labels to align native readout directions with internal anomaly representations.
QLMHtA7hoi.problem: MLLMs exhibit representation-behavior misalignment in video anomaly detection, where final decisions fail to exploit discriminative hidden states.
QLMHtA7hoi.method: RBA decomposes the gap into capacity and directional components and fine-tunes mid-to-late attention layers (~0.012% of parameters) using video-level labels to align the native normal-abnormal readout axis with internal representations.
QLMHtA7hoi.key_idea: Updates ~0.012% of parameters in mid-to-late attention layers under weak video-level supervision to rotate the native readout toward discriminative hidden-state directions.
QLMHtA7hoi.evidence: Experiments across three video anomaly detection benchmarks and multiple MLLM backbones, plus residual-stream tracing.

ibN0Som08V.one_liner: Factorizes frozen vision encoder readouts into support salience and operation identity slots for compositional edit evaluation.
ibN0Som08V.problem: Standard factor-wise probes allow operation laundering, crediting multiple spatial image edits through the same predicted slot without binding operation to location.
ibN0Som08V.method: The authors propose an injectively aligned leave-one-cell-out evaluation and the SO-OPF readout, which separates support salience from operation identity to explicitly bind where an edit occurs to what it does.
ibN0Som08V.key_idea: Factorizes frozen encoder readouts into separate support-salience and operation-identity components under an injectively aligned cell evaluation.
ibN0Som08V.evidence: Experiments on controlled synthetic scenes and image-disjoint natural images across encoder families against Dense-MLP and Joint-MLP readouts.

hItPV7ccOB.one_liner: Compiles time-series windows into numerical instruction tokens read by separate forecasters via joint training.
hItPV7ccOB.problem: Time-series forecasters experience shifting phase, trend, and shared channel activity that fixed predictors struggle to transfer across architectures.
hItPV7ccOB.method: An endogenous instruction language separates message generation from forecasting by training a compiler to map observed windows and horizons into shared and channel-aligned numerical messages, while architecture-specific readers learn to consume them. A frozen learned compiler can then transfer messages to new backbones and readers.
hItPV7ccOB.key_idea: A learned compiler translates time-series state into numerical instruction tokens that architecture-specific readers consume, enabling cross-backbone transfer.
hItPV7ccOB.evidence: Experiments span seven forecasting backbones, capacity-matched controls, fixed-weight interventions, held-out probes on FITS messages, and cross-backbone transfer.
hItPV7ccOB.claimed_gains: Reusing a FITS compiler with DLinear reduces MSE by 12.66% over a frozen-random compiler, and PatchTST messages with a DLinear reader reduce MSE by 7.56% across five seeds.

V1Cs9HZD4x.one_liner: Unifies video cropping, multimodal search, and web browsing in VideoRover, trained via synthesized trajectories and RL on VideoRover-Bench.
V1Cs9HZD4x.problem: Open-world video understanding requires both locating sparse visual evidence in videos and acquiring external knowledge via multi-step search, which are usually studied separately.
V1Cs9HZD4x.method: The authors propose VideoRover, an agentic framework coordinating video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing conditioned on accumulated observations, trained with an automated trajectory synthesis pipeline (26K SFT examples and 3K hard RL instances) and evaluated on VideoRover-Bench.
V1Cs9HZD4x.key_idea: Interleaving video clip localization with multimodal web search and browsing lets localized visual evidence anchor external search and vice versa.
V1Cs9HZD4x.evidence: Experiments on VideoDR and VideoRover-Bench comparing VideoRover-8B-RL against proprietary and larger tool-using models.

hj4i75KSaF.one_liner: Certifies two-stage LLM routing policies with conditional binomial and fixed-sequence tests via FS-Cert-U before utility optimization.
hj4i75KSaF.problem: Controlling selection-conditioned error rates in two-stage LLM routing is difficult because thresholds induce non-monotonic risk and data-dependent selection invalidates guarantees.
hj4i75KSaF.method: The authors propose FS-Cert-U, which orders a finite candidate policy family independently of certification data, applies exact conditional binomial and fixed-sequence tests to certify safe policies with family-wise error control, and then optimizes utility on the same data.
hj4i75KSaF.key_idea: Separating fixed-sequence safety certification from utility optimization on an independently ordered policy family avoids extra multiplicity penalties while handling non-monotonic risk.
hj4i75KSaF.evidence: Finite-sample theoretical guarantees and empirical evaluations across 33 QA routing configurations compared against Bonferroni and Holm baselines.
hj4i75KSaF.claimed_gains: Achieves higher utility than matched Bonferroni and Holm baselines at the primary operating point, with positive paired mean gains over Bonferroni in all 33 configurations.

l6TjLrpsyc.one_liner: Assigns turn-level credit in agentic RL via AgentOPSD by recursively updating a Bayesian belief state from self-distillation log-odds gaps.
l6TjLrpsyc.problem: Trajectory-level RL rewards fail to credit pivotal turns in long-horizon multi-turn agents, and prior self-distillation lacks a sequential credit formulation.
l6TjLrpsyc.method: The authors propose AgentOPSD, which aggregates token-level teacher-student log-probability gaps into turn-level evidence and recursively updates a Bayesian belief state in log-odds space, assigning turn-level credit via marginal belief revisions without critics or extra rollouts.
l6TjLrpsyc.key_idea: Recursively updating a log-odds Bayesian belief state with turn-level self-distillation log-probability gaps converts sparse outcome rewards into dense pivotal-turn credit.
l6TjLrpsyc.evidence: Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA using Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Qwen3-1.7B with ablations.
l6TjLrpsyc.claimed_gains: Reaches 89.1% success on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B, improving over GRPO and self-distillation baselines.

5put1epcJD.one_liner: Separates failed rollout actions by privileged likelihood shifts and applies progressive privilege distillation for agentic training.
5put1epcJD.problem: Failed agent trajectories mix useful progress with harmful actions, making uniform self-distillation or sparse outcome RL ineffective.
5put1epcJD.method: PESD rescores an agent's own rollouts under privileged training context, using likelihood shifts to partition actions into supported (forward distillation), rejected (low-weight unlikelihood), and uncertain (left to RL) regions. It schedules outcome feedback, gated skills, and verified trajectories along a progressive privilege hierarchy that decays over task visits and disappears at inference.
5put1epcJD.key_idea: Partitions failed-rollout actions via privileged likelihood shifts into forward distillation, unlikelihood, and RL regions while annealing privileged guidance.
5put1epcJD.evidence: Evaluated on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen3-1.7B, and on Search-QA.
5put1epcJD.claimed_gains: Reaches 92.2/66.1 on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct/Qwen3-1.7B and 46.0/44.0 on Search-QA.

ts0kgHyBfr.one_liner: Audits LLM self-improvement transition metrics against measured evaluation, training, and sharpening nulls, replacing them with exact base-model tests.
ts0kgHyBfr.problem: Problem-level self-improvement statistics compare two noisy estimates without measuring what they report when no real improvement has occurred.
ts0kgHyBfr.method: They audit three rounds of rank-32 LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B against frozen and unfiltered-placebo controls pushed through the identical pipeline, plus released curves of 21 models. They measure separate nulls for evaluation noise, training noise, and decoding sharpening, and introduce a per-problem exact test against base-model evaluations whose held-out null is zero.
ts0kgHyBfr.key_idea: Measures null baselines for evaluation noise, training noise, and sharpening to expose false self-improvement gains and replace them with exact per-problem tests.
ts0kgHyBfr.evidence: Audited three rounds of rank-32 LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B on AIME, a second model family, 128-768 sample budgets, and released curves of 21 models.
ts0kgHyBfr.claimed_gains: The standard expansion statistic credits a frozen model with 0.18-0.28 expansion on AIME across 128-768 samples, while self-training lowers pass@1 on 88-106 previously solved problems.

Ch35WAzCKc.one_liner: Introduces VideoGAIA, a 271-task benchmark evaluating multi-turn, tool-augmented agentic video understanding across multimodal LLMs.
Ch35WAzCKc.problem: Existing single-turn video QA benchmarks approach 90% accuracy saturation and fail to measure iterative, tool-augmented multimodal reasoning.
Ch35WAzCKc.method: VideoGAIA frames video understanding as a multi-turn interaction where models iteratively perceive video, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate evidence. It comprises 271 model-human co-designed tasks, each independently verified by three human experts.
Ch35WAzCKc.key_idea: Evaluates multimodal LLMs on multi-turn, tool-augmented video reasoning across 271 expert-verified tasks requiring iterative perception and tool use.
Ch35WAzCKc.evidence: Evaluated frontier multimodal LLMs including GPT-5.5 and Kimi-K3 on the 271 VideoGAIA tasks.
Ch35WAzCKc.claimed_gains: All evaluated MLLMs, including GPT-5.5 and Kimi-K3, achieve less than 60% accuracy on VideoGAIA.

glKPYaKKC5.one_liner: Benchmarks 58 document parsers across 4,425 matched Clean, Digital, and Real page images spanning 10 domains.
glKPYaKKC5.problem: Existing document parsing benchmarks lack matched clean, simulated-degraded, and real-captured page versions to isolate image-condition effects.
glKPYaKKC5.method: PureDocBench pairs 1,475 pages across 10 domains and 66 subcategories in matched Clean, Digital, and Real versions (4,425 images) with source-derived annotations for text, formulas, tables, and reading order.
glKPYaKKC5.key_idea: Holds page content and source-derived annotations fixed across matched Clean, digitally degraded, and real-captured document images.
glKPYaKKC5.evidence: Evaluates 58 pipeline-based parsers, end-to-end parsers, and general VLMs across all three tracks.
glKPYaKKC5.claimed_gains: The best three-track average score is 79.69 out of 100 (mean 63.84 across 58 models), with scores dropping by 3.34 points on Digital and 11.61 points on Real relative to Clean.

EyfLgNSMJk.one_liner: Pretrains an fMRI foundation model by predicting dropped-frame functional connectivity views from retained views with SIGReg.
EyfLgNSMJk.problem: Standard fMRI approaches collapse scans into a single Pearson correlation matrix, discarding frame-resolved cofluctuation variations.
EyfLgNSMJk.method: CoFlu-Brain partitions framewise fMRI cofluctuations into retained and dropped views summarized as FC matrices, trains an encoder to predict dropped-view representations across retained views, and applies SIGReg to prevent collapse.
EyfLgNSMJk.key_idea: Learns reproducible brain connectivity by predicting dropped-frame functional connectivity views from retained views under SIGReg collapse prevention.
EyfLgNSMJk.evidence: Pretrained on 13,444 subjects from eight dataset groups and evaluated via frozen-encoder linear probing on nine tasks across seven datasets.

L3MfygNX2E.one_liner: Integrates cross-head low-rank KV compression with mixed native-latent sparse attention and watermark-triggered runtime scheduling.
L3MfygNX2E.problem: Sparse attention reduces KV memory accesses but still keeps full KV caches resident in memory, limiting online LLM serving concurrency.
L3MfygNX2E.method: Duet uses a cross-head low-rank KV representation, a mixed native-latent attention kernel operating directly on compressed blocks without materialization, and watermark-triggered batched compression in the serving runtime.
L3MfygNX2E.key_idea: Executes sparse attention directly over mixed native and cross-head low-rank KV blocks managed via watermark-triggered batched compression.
L3MfygNX2E.evidence: Online LLM serving experiments measuring KV memory usage, throughput, and time-to-first-token (TTFT).
L3MfygNX2E.claimed_gains: Duet reduces KV memory usage by 4x, delivering up to 1.8x higher throughput and a 16.8x reduction in TTFT.

25DdNVKXg6.one_liner: Analyzes depth compatibility in looped transformers via low-rank adaptive readout interfaces across recurrent depths.
25DdNVKXg6.problem: Multi-depth training improves looped transformers with a shared output head, yet degrades accuracy when a separate readout head is fitted at a reference depth.
25DdNVKXg6.method: In controlled in-context linear regression, the authors compare fixed-depth and multi-depth looped transformers and test frozen cores equipped with low-dimensional shared readout adaptation directions.
25DdNVKXg6.key_idea: Measures excess prediction risk of shared versus separate depth readouts and recovers compatibility using a few shared adaptation directions.
25DdNVKXg6.evidence: Controlled in-context linear regression experiments across six models and three initialization pairs on 4,096-episode evaluations, plus an exact recurrence analysis.
25DdNVKXg6.claimed_gains: After freezing cores, two shared adaptation directions remove over 90% of the all-depth sharing cost in each of six models, and four directions reverse the training comparison.

6IstnZXa0a.one_liner: Demonstrates and formalizes how human-preference alignment reduces human-likeness in LLM response distributions.
6IstnZXa0a.problem: Preference alignment is often equated with human alignment, overlooking that what humans prefer from AI differs from what humans themselves would say.
6IstnZXa0a.method: The authors formalize the Turing-test gap, derive the restrictive condition required for preference alignment to preserve human response distributions, and measure human-response likelihood under varying preference weights and DPO.
6IstnZXa0a.key_idea: Formalizes the divergence between preference-aligned and human-like response distributions and tracks human-response likelihood across preference weighting and DPO.
6IstnZXa0a.evidence: Theoretical condition derivation and empirical evaluations of preference-weighted models and standard DPO on human preference and response data.

RoJiIFcc1v.one_liner: Extracts frozen ViT middle-layer internal neuron representations via attention and filters them with Fisher refinement for continual learning.
RoJiIFcc1v.problem: Analytic class-incremental learning methods transform or resample backbone output features, introducing feature drift and noise that degrade the updated classifier.
RoJiIFcc1v.method: InnerCIL extracts native local representations from middle layers of a frozen vision transformer using Attention-conditioned Native Dictionary Generation (ANDG) without transforming features. Fisher Refinement Analytic Classification (FRAC) then filters a subset of the multi-stage dictionary to reduce noise and speed up classifier updates.
RoJiIFcc1v.key_idea: Builds an untransformed native feature dictionary from frozen ViT middle-layer neuron responses and filters noisy samples via Fisher refinement.

JTISUDVXnr.one_liner: Selects extreme-compression video tokens via leverage-based greedy D-optimal design and a fixed-length residual readout.
JTISUDVXnr.problem: Extreme visual token compression in Video LLMs often discards sparse, transient evidence distributed across space and time.
JTISUDVXnr.method: DOVE builds a quality-weighted evidence representation combining visual semantics with spatial, temporal, dynamic, and optional query cues, then maximizes the log-determinant of a ridge-regularized information matrix via leverage-based greedy updates and local refinement, plus a fixed-length residual readout.
JTISUDVXnr.key_idea: Maximizes the log-determinant of a quality-weighted visual information matrix via greedy leverage updates to retain non-redundant video tokens.
JTISUDVXnr.evidence: Evaluated across VideoMME, EgoSchema, LongVideoBench, and MVBench on three Video LLM backbones.
JTISUDVXnr.claimed_gains: Outperforms the strongest evaluated baselines across four video benchmarks (exact numbers not stated in abstract).

l48B3YCMKX.one_liner: Provides a GPU-compiled JAX benchmark suite of five power market environments for multi-agent reinforcement learning.
l48B3YCMKX.problem: Existing power-market MARL environments focus on single markets, use simplified clearing, or rely on CPU solvers that bottleneck large-scale training.
l48B3YCMKX.method: PowerMarketJax implements five power market environments (day-ahead wholesale, real-time balancing, ancillary services, peer-to-peer double auctions, and local flexibility) with optimization-based clearing, pricing, and settlement compiled alongside policy training into a single GPU JAX graph.
l48B3YCMKX.key_idea: Compiles optimization-based power-market clearing, settlement, and MARL policy training into a single GPU-parallel JAX computation graph across five market designs.
l48B3YCMKX.evidence: Benchmarks independent learners across the five JAX market environments with 1,024 x 1,200 parallelism.
l48B3YCMKX.claimed_gains: Runs simulation and training on GPU with 1,024 x 1,200 parallelism across environments and market steps.

41v8X1mxps.one_liner: Separates candidate generation from upper-quantile nearest-neighbor batch selection for offline-to-online biological sequence design.
41v8X1mxps.problem: Limited experimental budgets cause model underestimation to discard high-performing biological sequences before evaluation.
41v8X1mxps.method: CRAFT generates candidate pools via measurement-guided search and local mutations, scores all candidates using an upper quantile of nearest-neighbor measured properties for diverse batch selection, and reallocates budgets across sources using accumulated measurements.
41v8X1mxps.key_idea: Decouples generation from selection using an upper-quantile nearest-neighbor score and adaptive source allocation across experimental rounds.
41v8X1mxps.evidence: Supported by a top-K mean objective gap bound and experiments on six RNA, DNA, and protein design benchmarks.
41v8X1mxps.claimed_gains: CRAFT achieves the highest mean top-128 score on five of six biological sequence design tasks.

Q9HBPZyidt.one_liner: Encodes four splice-site windows and tissue identity with a shared selective state-space block to predict cassette-exon inclusion.
Q9HBPZyidt.problem: Existing genomic sequence models classify individual splice sites rather than quantifying tissue-specific cassette-exon Percent Spliced In (PSI).
Q9HBPZyidt.method: SpliceMamba combines nucleotide sequence, genomic annotation, and tissue identity into unified tokens, encodes four splice-site-centered windows with a shared selective state-space block, and fuses them to predict tissue-conditioned PSI.
Q9HBPZyidt.key_idea: Applies a shared selective state-space encoder over four splice-site windows conditioned on tissue identity and genomic annotations to predict exon PSI.
Q9HBPZyidt.evidence: Evaluated on a 56-tissue splicing benchmark for pooled event-tissue correlation and pairwise tissue-differential inclusion.
Q9HBPZyidt.claimed_gains: Achieves 0.94 Pearson correlation across event-tissue pairs with 0.181M parameters (vs. 0.82-0.85 for adapted splice-site models) and 0.50 on tissue-differential inclusion (vs. 0.23-0.37).

6pkoUQn7Sw.one_liner: Pretrains protein representations from cryo-EM density maps using multi-head latent attention across local boxes.
6pkoUQn7Sw.problem: Existing cryo-EM protein methods lack a general-purpose pretraining framework and model local density-map boxes independently without capturing cross-box global structural context.
6pkoUQn7Sw.method: CryoProt introduces a Map Encoder with multi-head latent attention that lets box-level representations interact through a shared latent space. It uses multi-task pretraining to learn transferable representations for downstream tasks like protein flexibility prediction without requiring cryo-EM maps at inference.
6pkoUQn7Sw.key_idea: Models cross-box dependencies in partitioned cryo-EM density maps via multi-head latent attention over a shared latent space during multi-task pretraining.
6pkoUQn7Sw.evidence: Experiments across multiple protein property prediction benchmarks compare CryoProt against baseline methods.
6pkoUQn7Sw.claimed_gains: Achieves up to 12% improvement over the best-performing baselines across multiple benchmarks.

pfajkeag8r.one_liner: Learns CVAE degradation priors from unlabeled low-light images to synthesize training views for SAM 3 detection.
pfajkeag8r.problem: Low-light object detection lacks labeled target data, and preset synthesis rules miss real-world degradation combinations.
pfajkeag8r.method: CoDeS extracts seven physical descriptors from unlabeled low-light images and trains a conditional VAE conditioned on illumination modes to drive an online renderer that transforms labeled normal-light scenes while preserving bounding boxes. A lightweight Low-Light Feature Adapter is jointly trained with the SAM 3 detector on the synthesized views.
pfajkeag8r.key_idea: Trains an illumination-conditioned VAE over seven physical descriptors to render diverse low-light views of labeled normal-light images for joint adapter-detector training.
pfajkeag8r.evidence: Experiments on ExDark, NOD, and DARK FACE compare CoDeS against pretrained SAM 3 and alternative synthesis methods.

6LkmElN4a7.one_liner: Trains iterative text-to-image unified multimodal models using stage-specific teacher on-policy distillation and outcome optimization.
6LkmElN4a7.problem: Training iterative text-to-image unified multimodal models faces heterogeneous task objectives and sparse guidance from final-image rewards for intermediate reasoning and refinement steps.
6LkmElN4a7.method: ProOPD rolls out student text and image trajectories and supervises intermediate token prefixes and visual sampling states using frozen stage-specific teachers. It combines textual distribution matching, visual velocity matching, and image-level outcome optimization across reasoning, generation, reflection, and refinement stages.
6LkmElN4a7.key_idea: Applies frozen stage-specific teachers for on-policy textual distribution and visual velocity matching at intermediate student rollout states alongside outcome optimization.
6LkmElN4a7.evidence: Experiments and ablations on OneIG-EN, LongText-EN, WISE, and GenEval++ evaluate generation quality and iterative refinement.

89cECgVi4S.one_liner: Evaluating fine-grained steering in execution-grounded multi-turn interactions tests behavioral control and capability preservation beyond isolated generations.
89cECgVi4S.problem: Existing steering benchmarks use simplified single-attribute generation tasks that do not reflect practical interaction complexity or capability-preservation requirements.
89cECgVi4S.method: RealControlBench evaluates LLM and agent steering across concept and style, instruction following, safety, reasoning performance, and chain-of-thought length. It extends evaluation to execution-grounded and multi-turn agent interactions.
89cECgVi4S.key_idea: Fine-grained steering is evaluated across distinct behavioral targets and interactive settings rather than through isolated single-attribute generations.
89cECgVi4S.evidence: The supplied abstract specifies five evaluation dimensions but ends before reporting models, results, or experimental settings.

cRVrI4ULFN.one_liner: Scoring answers and supporting evidence across video, image, and text tests cross-modal anomaly reasoning beyond multiple-choice accuracy.
cRVrI4ULFN.problem: MLLM evaluation lacks a unified, credible benchmark for anomaly reasoning and evidence across video, image, and text modalities.
cRVrI4ULFN.method: UniAR builds over 40,199 question-answer pairs for dual anomaly discrimination, context understanding, fine-grained classification, and holistic analysis. It evaluates both answers and the evidence models provide for anomalous phenomena.
cRVrI4ULFN.key_idea: Evidence-based scoring tests whether MLLMs can justify anomaly answers, extending evaluation beyond standard multiple-choice correctness across modalities.
cRVrI4ULFN.evidence: The benchmark evaluates over 20 models on four shared challenge types spanning video, image, and text using public source data.

xRgpRQaqcN.one_liner: Error-focused prompt weighting teaches direct answers when reward coverage alone leaves list-index detection weak.
xRgpRQaqcN.problem: Guaranteed rewarded and unrewarded answers in every training group do not ensure that direct-answer learning transfers to new questions.
xRgpRQaqcN.method: The study isolates prompt weighting in group-relative RLVR using binary answers to execution-verified Python runtime-error questions on Qwen3-8B. It compares unmodified weighting with a rule that shifts weight toward prompts where the policy still errs.
xRgpRQaqcN.key_idea: Increase update weight on prompts with current policy errors instead of relying on final-answer coverage within each group.
xRgpRQaqcN.evidence: Frozen-state linear probes, supervised fine-tuning, and RLVR comparisons on Qwen3-8B test list-index error detection across three matched seeds and separate batch-total and adapter-step controls.
xRgpRQaqcN.claimed_gains: Error-focused weighting succeeds across three matched seeds, with the advantage holding under separate controls on batch coefficient totals and adapter step lengths.

4QvYQS54l8.one_liner: Excess-risk analysis identifies when low-rank adaptation generalizes better than full fine-tuning in noisy linear regression.
4QvYQS54l8.problem: LoRA's generalization behavior and rank choice lack theoretical understanding despite its widespread use for fine-tuning.
4QvYQS54l8.method: The paper compares LoRA and full fine-tuning through excess-risk analysis in noisy linear regression, covering overdetermined and underdetermined regimes and effectively low-rank task differences. Practical-task experiments test whether the resulting tradeoffs extend beyond linear regression.
4QvYQS54l8.key_idea: Restricting adaptation to a low-rank subspace changes excess risk according to the rank of the pretraining-to-downstream task difference.
4QvYQS54l8.evidence: Theory covers both overdetermined and underdetermined linear regression, while experiments on practical tasks examine the predicted rank-generalization tradeoffs.

dHl5b1GjT0.one_liner: Self-distills hindsight next-token distributions from a frozen LLM over verifier-accepted trajectories into persistent LoRA weights at test time.
dHl5b1GjT0.problem: Online test-time weight updates for long-horizon LLM agents destabilize the policy when directly imitating or reinforcing single execution trajectories.
dHl5b1GjT0.method: ASCENT addresses Online Agentic Test-Time Training by feeding each verifier-accepted trajectory as privileged hindsight context to a frozen initial copy of the LLM. The resulting next-token distributions are distilled into persistent LoRA fast weights to improve performance across subsequent tasks in the stream without an external teacher.
dHl5b1GjT0.key_idea: Uses a frozen copy of the LLM conditioned on verified trajectories as a hindsight teacher to distill updates into persistent LoRA weights.
dHl5b1GjT0.evidence: Evaluated on single-pass streams of long-horizon agentic tasks with terminal verification signals.

voFUHVlESb.one_liner: Migrates active LLM requests progressively by transferring temporally stable critical KV-cache blocks before background refilling.
voFUHVlESb.problem: Live migration for multi-instance LLM serving waits for full KV-cache transfer before releasing source GPU memory, delaying rescheduling under memory fragmentation and load imbalance.
voFUHVlESb.method: KVFlow exploits temporal sparsity stability of important KV-cache entries by tracking lightweight block-level attention statistics to pick migration-friendly requests. It transfers only the stable critical KV blocks so the destination GPU resumes decoding early and source memory is reclaimed, while remaining KV blocks refill in the background.
voFUHVlESb.key_idea: Hands off decoding after transferring temporally stable critical KV blocks selected via block-level attention statistics, then refills remaining blocks asynchronously.
voFUHVlESb.evidence: Evaluated as a multi-instance LLM serving rescheduling system.

GGw37srpoS.one_liner: Aligns unified image-text models against cross-modal semantic mis-grounding across full multi-turn trajectories.
GGw37srpoS.problem: Single-modality safety filters miss cross-modal semantic mis-grounding in unified multi-turn models, where benign standalone images and text combine to convey harmful thematic meanings.
GGw37srpoS.method: Uni-SafeR performs safety alignment across full multi-turn interaction trajectories spanning a first-turn generated image and a second-turn textual response. Its joint objective contrasts safe versus harmful text responses and benign versus mis-grounding image generations on a four-task dataset.
GGw37srpoS.key_idea: Applies trajectory-level contrastive safety alignment jointly over first-turn generated images and second-turn textual responses to suppress cross-modal semantic mis-grounding.
GGw37srpoS.evidence: Empirical evaluations across five unified models confirm semantic mis-grounding, and training is instantiated on a four-task dataset.

4OYtK4X3En.one_liner: Adds object-relative pose tokens and a metric point-cloud attention field to refine VLA and WAM robotic actions.
4OYtK4X3En.problem: Vision-language-action and world-action manipulation policies leave metric spatial relations among robot actions, manipulated objects, and scene geometry implicit.
4OYtK4X3En.method: The framework introduces Interaction-Centric Tokens (ICTs) representing end-effector pose trajectories relative to objects that are denoised jointly with actions, plus a Metric Action Interaction Field (MAIF) where action and ICT queries attend to metric scene point-cloud features for geometry-conditioned action corrections. A two-stage adaptation integrates both modules into pretrained VLA and WAM baselines.
4OYtK4X3En.key_idea: Jointly denoises object-relative pose tokens with actions and attends to metric scene point clouds to compute Cartesian action corrections.
4OYtK4X3En.evidence: Evaluated on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, real-world manipulation tasks, and out-of-distribution real-world evaluations across VLA and WAM baselines.
4OYtK4X3En.claimed_gains: Achieves average success-rate gains of 0.80 percentage points on LIBERO, 3.52 on RoboTwin 2.0, 6.13 on real-world tasks, and 7.45 on their out-of-distribution evaluations.

LWWo7oJPU6.one_liner: Constrains GRPO video exploration near the pretrained manifold using a curvature-corrected SDE, gradient equalizer, and dual trust region.
LWWo7oJPU6.problem: ODE-to-SDE exploration in video GRPO injects excess noise that degrades rollout quality and reward reliability, destabilizing post-training alignment.
LWWo7oJPU6.method: SAGE-GRPO enforces micro- and macro-level manifold constraints during video RL post-training. At the micro level it uses a manifold-aware SDE with logarithmic curvature correction and a temporal gradient norm equalizer; at the macro level it applies a dual KL trust region combining a periodic moving anchor with stepwise constraints.
LWWo7oJPU6.key_idea: Combines a logarithmically curvature-corrected SDE, temporal gradient-norm equalization, and a dual moving-anchor KL trust region to keep exploration near the pretrained manifold.
LWWo7oJPU6.evidence: Evaluated on HunyuanVideo1.5 with VideoAlign and HPSV3 rewards, and generalized to image generation on SD3.5-medium and FLUX.1-dev with HPSV3.

BJlDHn1L8T.one_liner: Governs multi-agent procedural memory via coordination-scope preservation, dual-timescale reliability tracking, and paired-replay reactivation.
BJlDHn1L8T.problem: Multi-agent procedural memory suffers from memory pollution and scope collapse when flawed or out-of-scope procedures are reused across incompatible coordination levels under ambiguous task feedback.
BJlDHn1L8T.method: AECG turns multi-agent memory into a dynamic governance loop that preserves coordination scope and tracks multi-scale, confidence-aware reliability to detect procedure degradation. It prioritizes high-risk memories by combining degradation with downstream impact under a review budget, applies targeted revisions, and reactivates skills only after paired replay.
BJlDHn1L8T.key_idea: Preserves coordination scope, detects degradation via dual-timescale reliability, prioritizes reviews by downstream impact, and gates skill reactivation on paired replay.
BJlDHn1L8T.evidence: Evaluated across three multi-agent frameworks and four benchmarks (12 total settings).
BJlDHn1L8T.claimed_gains: AECG achieves the best score in 11 of 12 benchmark-framework settings.

EihUVmf6eC.one_liner: Introduces a report-grounded upper-GI endoscopy multimodal benchmark aligning six clinical task families with matched visual evidence scopes.
EihUVmf6eC.problem: Existing endoscopic benchmarks do not systematically align clinical task definitions with the scope of visual evidence required, from compact local views to full-examination frames.
EihUVmf6eC.method: TraceScope builds a report-grounded upper-GI endoscopy benchmark organized around a shared clinical specification covering site recognition, abnormal findings, finding attributes, report generation, diagnostic impression, and guideline reasoning. For each item, the provided visual context is matched to clinical evidence needs, from compact target views to redundant examination-level sequences.
EihUVmf6eC.key_idea: Aligns six upper-GI clinical task families with task-matched visual evidence scopes across examination frames grounded in clinical reports.
EihUVmf6eC.evidence: Main board comprises 9,106 task-specific items from 4,893 examinations and 70,386 item-frame references.

r9NBqCe7RJ.one_liner: Stores unretained web search-and-visit residuals with provenance and selectively reuses them via a stage-aware gate.
r9NBqCe7RJ.problem: Deep research web agents discard task-relevant signals from unvisited search results, visited page content, and source appraisals when updating their research state.
r9NBqCe7RJ.method: WasteHub is a plug-and-play module that stores Unvisited-result, Visit-content, and Source-appraisal waste as typed, provenance-preserving residuals. A stage-aware gate selectively reuses these residuals during research without altering the host framework's planner or search/visit interfaces.
r9NBqCe7RJ.key_idea: Caches unretained search, visit, and source-appraisal signals as typed provenance-preserving residuals and re-injects them through a stage-aware gate.
r9NBqCe7RJ.evidence: Evaluated on DeepResearch Bench and DeepResearch Bench II using ReAct (against Base, PRM-F, and PAE), plus cross-framework tests with Self-Manager and WebWeaver and component ablations.

0rOyxBlqtn.one_liner: Recursively re-diagnoses residuals of frozen time-series forecasters to allocate validation-gated directional and bounded correction units.
0rOyxBlqtn.problem: In sequential post-hoc error correction for frozen time-series forecasters, accepting one update alters the residual distribution so an earlier error basis no longer captures remaining predictable directions.
0rOyxBlqtn.method: GateCorrect performs recursive self-improvement by re-diagnosing the current residual at each round, allocating a new correction unit with a directional path for predictable error patterns and a bounded path using the original window level, and admitting the unit only if validation approves it.
0rOyxBlqtn.key_idea: Iteratively re-estimates the residual error basis after each validation-gated correction unit combining directional pattern weights with a bounded level path.
0rOyxBlqtn.evidence: Evaluated across three forecasters and seven datasets (252 single-unit runs, 216 matched RSI runs, a 36-run H96 panel, PEMS, and white-box fine-tuning/LoRA comparisons).
0rOyxBlqtn.claimed_gains: One unit cuts test MSE by 3.74% over 252 runs (4.91% vs 0.04%–0.27% for fine-tuning/LoRA); RSI raises mean reduction from 2.18% to 2.81% across 216 runs (improving 32 of 37 accepted runs); refreshing the span adds 0.30 percentage points overall, 1.15 points on H96, and lifts PEMS reduction from 22.21% to 27.85%.

En7eV0AnzL.one_liner: Unifies individual and interactive human motion understanding and generation via factorized motion-relation latents and Mixture-of-Transformers.
En7eV0AnzL.problem: Unified motion-language models struggle to balance understanding and generation objectives in shared parameters while capturing multi-participant dynamics and relative geometry.
En7eV0AnzL.method: I²MoT introduces a Compositional Motion-Relation Representation (CMR) that factorizes interactions into continuous participant motion latents and continuous relative geometry, paired with a task-specific Mixture-of-Transformers over a frozen language backbone. Participant-first, motion-grounded Chain-of-Thought targets supervise understanding and improve generation through shared motion-interface parameters while inference stays prompt-only.
En7eV0AnzL.key_idea: Factorizes interactive motion into continuous participant and relative-geometry latents processed by a task-specific Mixture-of-Transformers with a frozen LLM backbone.
En7eV0AnzL.evidence: Evaluated on HumanML3D and InterHuman for individual and interactive motion generation and understanding.

EGJmJ3iKGM.one_liner: Aligns rectified-flow text-to-image models via deterministic policy optimization using a local velocity Bradley-Terry reward model.
EGJmJ3iKGM.problem: Image-level reward alignment is flow-blind and rewards curved and straight paths equally, distorting pretrained rectified-flow geometry and hurting few-step sampling quality.
EGJmJ3iKGM.method: Flow-VPA trains BT-Flow, a Bradley-Terry reward model over state-velocity pairs conditioned on intermediate state, time, and prompt that prefers straight-line velocities toward chosen images over rejected ones. Treating predicted velocities as deterministic actions, Flow-VPA updates the flow policy directly via on-policy reward gradients without SDE conversion or trajectory likelihood evaluation.
EGJmJ3iKGM.key_idea: Lifts image preference pairs into local straight-line velocity preferences via BT-Flow and updates deterministic flow velocities directly with on-policy reward gradients.
EGJmJ3iKGM.evidence: Formulated and evaluated for text-to-image rectified-flow preference alignment.

X31pnGGh8D.one_liner: Orchestrates AI video production using a SFT+GRPO-trained Director editing a dynamic task stack over descriptor-registered sub-agents.
X31pnGGh8D.problem: Automated video production systems rely on rigid pipelines, while general-purpose LLMs remain unreliable at long-horizon orchestration and multimodal asset routing.
X31pnGGh8D.method: FRAMEWORKERS pairs a Director that dynamically edits a Dynamic Task Stack to route tasks and replan after failures with an Assistant executing against a persistent shared Workspace of scripts, assets, and memory. Modular capabilities register via natural-language descriptors, and the Director is trained with supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO.
X31pnGGh8D.key_idea: Trains a Director via SFT and GRPO to manage a dynamic task stack and route work across descriptor-specified sub-agents sharing a persistent workspace.
X31pnGGh8D.evidence: Evaluated on chain-level routing accuracy against LLM planners and recovery from injected runtime faults.
X31pnGGh8D.claimed_gains: FRAMEWORKERS reaches 88.4% chain-level routing accuracy versus 71.2% for the strongest evaluated LLM planner and recovers from 96.7% of injected runtime failures.

ZawoaZWw6m.one_liner: Prunes and merges video patches before ViT encoding using pixel-space differences and quadtree dynamic programming.
ZawoaZWw6m.problem: Long, high-resolution videos contain heavy spatiotemporal redundancy, yet existing visual token pruning happens after ViT encoding or requires learned auxiliary selection networks.
ZawoaZWw6m.method: FlashGaze is a training-free pre-ViT patch pruning method that uses pixel-space differences as an information-loss proxy. It applies Quadtree Dynamic Programming to jointly choose patch dropping, merging, and keeping under a fixed token budget without auxiliary networks.
ZawoaZWw6m.key_idea: Solves a quadtree dynamic program over pixel-space difference costs to drop, merge, or keep video patches prior to ViT encoding.
ZawoaZWw6m.evidence: Evaluated on two MLLM backbones including Qwen3-VL-8B across multiple benchmarks including LongVideoBench.
ZawoaZWw6m.claimed_gains: On Qwen3-VL-8B and LongVideoBench, FlashGaze retains 98% of full-input baseline accuracy while accelerating ViT encoding up to 5.4×, MLLM prefill up to 17×, and reducing peak GPU memory by 1.8×.

UEDgw58mJC.one_liner: Aligns multimodal knowledge-graph sub-entities via role-conditioned optimal transport and reweights hard negatives by role-consistency risk.
UEDgw58mJC.problem: Multimodal knowledge graph completion methods rely on coarse entity-level fusion that misses relation-specific sub-entity correspondences and suffer from false-negative bias during hard-negative training.
UEDgw58mJC.method: RHDN constructs relation- and role-conditioned optimal transport couplings between visual and textual sub-entities and aggregates them with hierarchical role prototypes. During training, it decouples negative difficulty (model scores) from false-negative risk (multimodal role-consistency evidence) using KL-regularized reweighting.
UEDgw58mJC.key_idea: Couples visual and textual sub-entities via relation- and role-conditioned optimal transport and applies KL-regularized negative reweighting separating score hardness from multimodal role-consistency risk.
UEDgw58mJC.evidence: Evaluated on three multi-modal knowledge graph completion benchmarks against existing MMKGC baselines.

iaMmGPCgNV.one_liner: Uses a reasoning LLM to iteratively propose and validate block-revisiting compute programs for frozen time-series foundation models.
iaMmGPCgNV.problem: Pretrained time-series foundation models execute a fixed single pass regardless of forecast horizon or task difficulty, leaving extra inference-time compute unused.
iaMmGPCgNV.method: Recursive inference represents test-time compute allocation as programs that revisit consecutive encoder blocks, control update sizes, and choose mutable tokens while keeping weights frozen. A reasoning model proposes programs, inspects historical-window errors, and revises proposals; held-out later windows decide whether to deploy a fixed program at test time.
iaMmGPCgNV.key_idea: Searches over frozen-model block-revisiting compute programs using a reasoning LLM guided by historical forecasting windows and gated by held-out validation windows.
iaMmGPCgNV.evidence: Evaluated across 56 forecasting tasks from 14 datasets using frozen pretrained time-series foundation models.
iaMmGPCgNV.claimed_gains: Reduces test MSE by 4.02% on average across 56 tasks at 1.28x the baseline encoder-block evaluations per forecast.

j9vhh2iZPG.one_liner: Assigns role-matched local and trajectory-level RL advantages across multi-agent turns and routes dual proposer rewards to distinct token spans.
j9vhh2iZPG.problem: Outcome-level RL gives every multi-agent turn the same terminal reward, misattributing positive credit to erroneous actions that later agents repair.
j9vhh2iZPG.method: Role-Aware Credit Assignment (RACA) keeps trajectory-level credit for controller decisions, scores worker actions with locally observable outcomes, computes relative advantages within groups matched by role, blackboard context, and reward channel, and routes solution-quality versus assistance-seeking advantages to separate token spans in primary proposer outputs using only original rollouts.
j9vhh2iZPG.key_idea: Matches relative advantages by role, blackboard context, and reward channel while routing solution-quality and assistance-seeking rewards to separate proposer token spans without extra rollouts.
j9vhh2iZPG.evidence: Evaluated with Qwen3-8B on MATH Level 5 and AIME 2022-2026 against adaptive multi-agent baselines including Outcome GRPO.
j9vhh2iZPG.claimed_gains: Reaches 64.5% accuracy on MATH Level 5 and 16.0% on AIME 2022-2026 (+6.4 and +6.0 percentage points over Outcome GRPO), using 7.4 average model calls per MATH problem versus 8.7-10.7 for other adaptive methods.

aoenJrugDU.one_liner: Aggregates recurring failure evidence across tasks before promoting collaborative harness modifications for LLM agents.
aoenJrugDU.problem: Failure-driven agent harness evolution that modifies harnesses from individual failures overfits to isolated model limitations and hurts cross-task and cross-model generalization.
aoenJrugDU.method: Ecdysis accumulates failure evidence across distinct task instances to isolate recurring systematic harness deficiencies before updating the harness, and uses collaborative failure analysis to refine modification specifications.
aoenJrugDU.key_idea: Promotes harness edits only from failure patterns recurring across distinct tasks and refines specifications via collaborative failure analysis.
aoenJrugDU.evidence: Evaluated across multiple LLMs and benchmarks (specific names not stated in available abstract text).

CKQbSLShPj.one_liner: Reduces quadrature spectral reparameterization to an exact single-kernel AdamW moment reduction and branch-free readout step-size multiplier.
CKQbSLShPj.problem: Auxiliary spectral readouts improve time-series forecasting even when algebraically foldable into a single kernel, leaving the underlying optimization mechanism unexplained.
CKQbSLShPj.method: Analyzing quadrature reparameterization in a Phase-Structured Predictor (PSP), the authors derive SpecScale-Exact, an exact two-to-one reduction of AdamW moment states preserving finite-epsilon denominators and clipping, and distill its effect into a branch-free Fixed-bin readout multiplier (1+n/c_b) and uniform interior simplification (1+n/2).
CKQbSLShPj.key_idea: Exploits quadrature's signed-permutation structure to collapse AdamW moments two-to-one into a branch-free readout step-size multiplier (1+n/c_b) with zero inference overhead.
CKQbSLShPj.evidence: FP64 replay equivalence checks on PSP and FITS architectures, plus experiments across 32 weighted-PSP cells and two diagnostic cells.
CKQbSLShPj.claimed_gains: Fixed-bin and its uniform simplification (1+n/2) recover 96.5% and 97.7% of QR's gain under closure; across 32 weighted-PSP cells, Fixed-bin lowers mean cell-relative test MSE by 3.158% (27/32 wins) over equal-budget global tuning, while unguided three-trial searches incur 2.78-11.91% higher expected test MSE and 1.79-3.62x more training updates on two diagnostic cells.

Q6DjzoeM4x.one_liner: Detects dynamic 3D contact regions and predicts time-agnostic impulse-induced velocity changes from multi-view videos.
Q6DjzoeM4x.problem: Existing dynamic 3D scene models struggle to extrapolate future frames of interacting objects because they rely on absolute timestamps rather than underlying physical interaction dynamics.
Q6DjzoeM4x.method: PhysAtObj learns 3D object interaction dynamics directly from multi-view videos without explicit physical parameters via an object interaction module that identifies dynamic contact regions and directions and predicts time-agnostic, impulse-induced velocity changes from object physical states.
Q6DjzoeM4x.key_idea: Identifies dynamic contact regions and directions to predict time-agnostic, impulse-induced velocity changes conditioned on physical states rather than absolute timestamps.
Q6DjzoeM4x.evidence: Evaluated on PhysInOne and newly introduced synthetic and real-world multi-view video datasets for future frame extrapolation.

sGAZ1mKXJX.one_liner: Forecasts macro-grid dynamics first, selectively refines event-critical micro-regions top-down, and learns sparse regime-adaptive adjacency matrices.
sGAZ1mKXJX.problem: Spatio-temporal forecasting methods using fixed spatial partitions or uniform refinement fail to balance global efficiency with local fidelity during regime shifts or abrupt events.
sGAZ1mKXJX.method: AR-MGNet aggregates fine-grained inputs into functional macro-grids to predict a coherent macroscopic future, selectively recovers micro-scale innovations in event-critical regions via a top-down adaptive refinement pathway, and constructs sparse relation-aware adjacency matrices adapted to the current spatial regime.
sGAZ1mKXJX.key_idea: Performs bidirectional macro-to-micro multi-grid reconciliation with selective top-down micro refinement in event-critical regions and dynamic sparse adjacency learning.
sGAZ1mKXJX.evidence: Evaluated with ablations across four LargeST traffic benchmarks and five cross-domain datasets (wind, air quality, EV charging, electricity, solar).

DDFEBjXIO2.one_liner: Splits vision backbone channels across parallel blocks that exchange information through shared public channels without widening downstream outputs.
DDFEBjXIO2.problem: Directly widening vision backbones increases representation capacity but incurs heavy dense channel-processing costs.
DDFEBjXIO2.method: Parallel Block Interaction (PBI) distributes feature channels across multiple parallel backbone-specific blocks while maintaining shared public channels for lateral information exchange via public-to-public, private-to-public, and private-to-private interactions, preserving downstream feature width.
DDFEBjXIO2.key_idea: Partitions channels across parallel vision blocks linked laterally through shared public channels with controllable public/private channel interactions.
DDFEBjXIO2.evidence: Evaluated on ConvNeXt, ViT, Swin Transformer, and VMamba for image classification and dense prediction against direct channel expansion and Mixture-of-Experts, with ablations.

U1JptdfbDT.one_liner: Represents reusable candidate claims in a signed factor graph and budgets partial-verification queries to improve Best-of-N selection.
U1JptdfbDT.problem: Best-of-N selection assumes dependable whole-response verifiers, whereas many vision-language tasks only allow partial verification of individual claims shared across candidates.
U1JptdfbDT.method: Best-of-Evidence (BoE) fixes the Best-of-N candidate pool, encodes recurring claims with opposing stances in a signed candidate-factor graph, and uses a score-based controller to allocate a limited verification budget to evidence actions capable of changing the winning candidate (recovering standard BoN at zero budget).
U1JptdfbDT.key_idea: Models shared claims across a fixed Best-of-N pool with a signed candidate-factor graph and allocates budgeted partial-verification queries that can flip the selection.
U1JptdfbDT.evidence: Theoretical query-complexity analysis in a factor-code model plus common-ledger experiments across four medical VQA settings.
U1JptdfbDT.claimed_gains: Theoretically shows shared factor queries achieve an O(log K) versus Theta(K) query separation in a factor-code model; empirical numerical gains are not stated.

UFHhuoaHiX.one_liner: Synthesizes native audio-visual dialogues via a multi-agent engine, benchmarks five abilities with rubric-based LLM judging, and trains with RL.
UFHhuoaHiX.problem: Native audio-visual dialogue without separate text queries or external ASR/captioning lacks real-world training recordings and reliable evaluation beyond brittle keyword matching.
UFHhuoaHiX.method: The authors introduce OmniVChat-Studio, a multi-agent data engine synthesizing single- and multi-turn audio-visual dialogues; OmniVChat-Bench, covering five dialogue ability categories scored by an LLM judge under explicit criteria; and OmniVChat-RL, a reinforcement learning reward design for audio-visual dialogue.
UFHhuoaHiX.key_idea: Uses multi-agent audio-visual dialogue synthesis to build training data and a rubric-judged five-category benchmark, paired with an RL reward design.
UFHhuoaHiX.evidence: Introduces OmniVChat-Studio, OmniVChat-Bench (five ability categories), and OmniVChat-RL for omni audio-visual dialogue models.

LFrK1P5zss.one_liner: Samples binary codebook representations, scores them in heterogeneous teacher spaces, and reinforces high-advantage selections for medical vision distillation.
LFrK1P5zss.problem: Distilling heterogeneous medical vision and vision-language foundation models into a compact vision-only clinical student is hard because teachers have mismatched modalities, objectives, and representation spaces.
LFrK1P5zss.method: HiPPO samples candidate student representations as binary selections over a unified codebook, scores them in each teacher's native space via teacher-specific projectors and compatibility functions, and applies group-relative reinforcement to drive position-wise visual distillation and privileged training-only VLM semantic distillation. The authors also introduce MedBridge-Bench (>18,000 CT, MRI, and PET/CT studies).
LFrK1P5zss.key_idea: Treats codebook representation selection as an on-policy RL problem scored in each heterogeneous teacher's native space with group-relative feedback.
LFrK1P5zss.evidence: Evaluated on MedBridge-Bench spanning case-level disease diagnosis and voxel-level lesion recognition over more than 18,000 volumetric CT, MRI, and PET/CT studies.

HJfM2wGr0q.one_liner: Prunes 3D-rendered visual tokens via geometric visibility masks and an anomaly-aware selector, then recalibrates CLIP text prototypes.
HJfM2wGr0q.problem: CLIP-based zero-shot 3D anomaly detection wastes compute on background and normal surface tokens across multi-view renders, while token pruning shifts visual features away from CLIP text prototypes.
HJfM2wGr0q.method: SwiftAD removes unsupported background tokens parameter-free using rendering-derived 3D-to-2D geometric visibility masks, retains informative object tokens with a lightweight anomaly-aware selector, and adapts separate global and local CLIP text prototypes with residual calibration to correct pruning-induced feature shift.
HJfM2wGr0q.key_idea: Combines parameter-free 3D-to-2D geometric visibility masking, anomaly-aware token selection, and residual-calibrated global/local CLIP text prototype adaptation.
HJfM2wGr0q.evidence: Evaluated on MVTec3D-AD, Eyecandies, and Real3D-AD against unpruned CLIP-based zero-shot 3D anomaly detection baselines.
HJfM2wGr0q.claimed_gains: Halves computational cost and improves throughput by 73.9% over the unpruned baseline while preserving zero-shot performance.

DMczRQpvPK.one_liner: Empirically analyzes prompt count, domain source, and selection in on-policy distillation across teacher-student pairs.
DMczRQpvPK.problem: How prompt quantity, domain source, and selection strategy govern transfer across different teacher-student pairs in on-policy distillation is poorly understood.
DMczRQpvPK.method: The authors systematically vary prompt count, domain source, and selection across RL-continuation, SFT-continuation, and cross-model OPD pairs, measuring both parameter and functional teacher-student alignment across prompt supports.
DMczRQpvPK.key_idea: Shows that OPD prompt utility is relational to the teacher-student pair rather than intrinsic, separating prompt efficiency from prompt interchangeability via functional alignment analysis.
DMczRQpvPK.evidence: Experiments across RL- and SFT-continuation and cross-model OPD pairs using DAPO and DeepMath prompts, with parameter/functional alignment and selection comparisons.
DMczRQpvPK.claimed_gains: Four DAPO prompts match the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts.

x359pWENg0.one_liner: Atomizes federated textual gradients into routable rules, measures target-client utility, and composes scope-compatible prompts under a token budget.
x359pWENg0.problem: Federated textual optimization compresses client updates into one shared global prompt, assuming textual gradients help all clients despite heterogeneous client distributions.
x359pWENg0.method: SCOPED-FEDTEXTGRAD splits local prompt revisions into independently routable rules, estimates each rule's client-wise support (scope), and composes only scope-compatible rules under a hard token budget; a validation-gated variant (SAFE-SCOPED) falls back to the local prompt when sharing lacks validation support.
x359pWENg0.key_idea: Decomposes local textual gradients into atomic rules and routes only client-scope-compatible rules under a prompt-token budget with optional validation fallback.
x359pWENg0.evidence: Analysis of 2,070 textual-gradient rules across 108 federated runs and six language models, plus comparisons against Local TextGrad and unconstrained concatenation.
x359pWENg0.claimed_gains: Only 0.4% of rules are globally beneficial while 85.4% have partial client scope; SCOPED-FEDTEXTGRAD improves average accuracy over Local TextGrad using approximately 73% fewer prompt tokens than unconstrained concatenation.

rHVNuGP2yx.one_liner: Trains a continuous GFlowNet sampler over variable-length latent reasoning trajectories using entropy-weighted subtrajectory balance.
rHVNuGP2yx.problem: Explicit CoT incurs high token-decoding overhead, while existing continuous latent reasoning methods learn deterministic or reward-maximizing paths without principled cost-quality allocation.
rHVNuGP2yx.method: Latent Thought Flow (LTF) models reasoning as variable-length continuous trajectories sampled by a continuous GFlowNet with stochastic latent transitions matching a reward-induced posterior over answer quality and compute cost, trained via an Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance objective and a reference-prior regularizer.
rHVNuGP2yx.key_idea: Samples variable-length continuous reasoning trajectories with a stochastic GFlowNet trained via entropy-weighted subtrajectory balance and reference-prior regularization.
rHVNuGP2yx.evidence: Evaluated under finetuning and transfer learning settings against explicit CoT and latent reasoning baselines.
rHVNuGP2yx.claimed_gains: Improves accuracy by 9.5% while reducing reasoning length by 27.2% on average compared with strong latent reasoning methods.

xOyVwhrHFm.one_liner: Identifies and explains a rank-dependent confidence-ordering reversal when shallow-fused contextual priors reshape neural decoding margins.
xOyVwhrHFm.problem: Reading confidence from shallow-fused scores in neural-to-language decoding can make uncorrected residual errors appear more confident than prior-repaired predictions without changing accuracy.
xOyVwhrHFm.method: Studying MEG speech retrieval under additive shallow fusion with fused top-two margin confidence, the authors uncover a confidence-ordering reversal across initial local ranks, explain it via initial score deficits limiting repair margins, verify it by causally intervening on the fusion weight, and note in the TL;DR that separating local and prior scores recovers ordering.
xOyVwhrHFm.key_idea: Shows that additive shallow fusion caps repair margins by initial candidate deficits while letting residual errors grow large margins between wrong candidates at deeper ranks.
xOyVwhrHFm.evidence: Speech retrieval experiments on MEG-MASC and MOUS using additive shallow fusion and causal interventions on the fusion weight.
xOyVwhrHFm.claimed_gains: On MEG-MASC, pooled correctness AUROC is 0.87, whereas repair-vs-residual-error AUROC drops from 0.70 at initial ranks 2-3 to 0.39 at ranks 21-50, with errors starting beyond rank 20 comprising 46.6% of post-fusion errors.

ejNvJX3NxP.one_liner: Distills frozen bidirectional video diffusion models into causal students using decoupled slow and fast experts for high- and low-noise regimes.
ejNvJX3NxP.problem: Converting bidirectional video diffusion models into causal few-step students via offline PF-ODE trajectories is prohibitively expensive, while reducing supervision to a single sample causes quality collapse.
ejNvJX3NxP.method: Tracing single-sample collapse to conflicting trajectory curvature between high-noise layout/motion and low-noise texture regimes, Glance Forcing keeps the pretrained teacher frozen and decouples denoising into complementary slow and fast experts trained with stage-specific objectives.
ejNvJX3NxP.key_idea: Decouples causal video diffusion distillation into separate slow and fast experts with stage-specific objectives for high-noise layout and low-noise texture regimes.
ejNvJX3NxP.evidence: Empirical diagnosis of single-sample trajectory collapse and teacher trajectory geometry for distilling bidirectional diffusion into causal few-step video models.

IPOA8cdiZU.one_liner: Uses dual canvas/subject paths and a learned binary gate routing subject-centric or background-anchored positional embeddings for coarse-mask editing.
IPOA8cdiZU.problem: Coarse-mask local image editing must preserve unmasked backgrounds while generating subjects whose shapes differ from the coarse user mask.
IPOA8cdiZU.method: BRIDGE pairs a full-canvas Main Path with a local Subject Path and a learned discrete binary gate that assigns each Subject token either subject-centric or background-anchored positional embeddings, instantiated on Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and FLUX.2 [klein] 9B Base with dense bounding-box training supporting optional mask-cropped inference.
IPOA8cdiZU.key_idea: Separates full-canvas synthesis from local subject editing via dual paths and a learned binary gate choosing subject-centric or background-anchored positional embeddings per token.
IPOA8cdiZU.evidence: Instantiated on Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and FLUX.2 [klein] 9B Base and evaluated on ICE-Bench under shared rewritten prompts against mask-free FLUX.2 Base and ACE++.
IPOA8cdiZU.claimed_gains: On ICE-Bench, FLUX.2 BRIDGE reduces outside-mask L1 by 64.4% relative to FLUX.2 Base and by 59.5% relative to ACE++, while improving mean task score by 1.7% and prompt following by 6.5% over ACE++.

gPARqBeh10.one_liner: Applies Lorentz transformations parameterized by joint spacetime coordinates to attention queries and keys for translation-invariant spatiotemporal coupling.
gPARqBeh10.problem: Physics-based spatiotemporal models restrict flexibility, whereas standard neural architectures leave time-space coupling implicit.
gPARqBeh10.method: Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE) uses joint temporal and spatial coordinates to parameterize Lorentz transformations on query and key features so dot-product attention depends only on relative spacetime displacement while preserving global translation invariance and compatibility with fast attention kernels.
gPARqBeh10.key_idea: Applies spacetime-coordinate-parameterized Lorentz transformations to queries and keys so dot-product attention depends strictly on relative spacetime displacement.
gPARqBeh10.evidence: Evaluated on nine multi-trajectory microscopic molecular dynamics tasks and macroscopic KTH video prediction.
gPARqBeh10.claimed_gains: Achieves the best results on all nine multi-trajectory molecular evaluations and reduces KTH video-prediction MSE by 9.9% relative to the best compared baseline while using roughly one-tenth as many parameters/resources (unit truncated).

fXt5rH6mod.one_liner: Formalizes the Linear Representation Hypothesis as a family of claims distinguished by group-action representation equivalences.
fXt5rH6mod.problem: Discussions of the Linear Representation Hypothesis omit explicit representation-equivalence criteria, causing probes, metrics, and interventions to test different hypotheses under one label.
fXt5rH6mod.method: This position paper formalizes representation equivalence via group actions, explicitly specifying the representation object, extraction procedure, asserted property, and architecture-induced equivalences, and applies this lens to audit standard representation metrics and recent interpretability analyses.
fXt5rH6mod.key_idea: Parameterizes linear representation claims by a group action defining representation equivalence alongside the object, extraction procedure, and asserted property.
fXt5rH6mod.evidence: Conceptual formalization via group actions and an audit of common representation quantities and recent interpretability analyses.

90oZpTMT1u.one_liner: Injects Gumbel-Softmax noise into soft-thinking token probabilities and uses Gumbel reparameterization for GRPO credit assignment.
90oZpTMT1u.problem: Combining continuous soft-thinking reasoning with verifiable-reward RL like GRPO underperforms discrete-token CoT RL because injecting stochasticity and assigning credit to soft tokens is difficult.
90oZpTMT1u.method: SofT-GRPO injects Gumbel noise into token probability distributions via Gumbel-Softmax for controllable stochasticity during soft-thinking rollouts and applies the Gumbel reparameterization trick to perform policy optimization and credit assignment.
90oZpTMT1u.key_idea: Applies Gumbel-Softmax noise injection and Gumbel reparameterization to enable stochastic rollouts and gradient credit assignment in soft-thinking GRPO.
90oZpTMT1u.evidence: Evaluated on LLMs from 1.5B to 7B parameters comparing SofT-GRPO against discrete-token CoT GRPO on Pass@1 and Pass@32.
90oZpTMT1u.claimed_gains: Outperforms discrete-token CoT GRPO by +0.13% on average Pass@1 accuracy and +2.19% on average Pass@32.
